russian: Мы ещё не обговорили оплату труда Драконьей стражи.
bulgarian: We haven't discussed the Dragonguard's payment yet.

english: I think special thanks are in order to one Mistrian in particular...
french: Je crois que des remerciements s'imposent pour une personne de Mistria en particulier...
russian: Я думаю, один из жителей Мистрии заслужил особую благодарность...
bulgarian: I think special thanks are in order to one Mistrian in particular...

english: Well done [Ari]! We all appreciate your hard work!
french: Bravo, [Ari] ! Nous te sommes tous reconnaissants pour ton travail !
russian: Хорошая работа, [Ari]! Мы все признательны тебе за труд.
bulgarian: Well done [Ari]! We all appreciate your hard work!

english: Hear, hear!
french: Bien dit, bravo !
russian: Точно, точно!
bulgarian: Hear, hear!

english: Now, on to new business-
french: Bien, concernant les nouvelles tâches...
russian: А теперь поговорим о новых делах...
bulgarian: Now, on to new business-

english: How about some old business, old people!
french: Et si on parlait des vieilles tâches, hein, les vieilles personnes !
russian: А как насчёт старых дел, старички?
bulgarian: How about some old business, old people!

english: [Ari]! I'm so glad you could make it to our meeting!
french: [Ari] ! Je suis si contente que tu aies pu venir à notre réunion !
russian: [Ari]!  Я рада, что у тебя получилось прийти на наше совещание.
bulgarian: [Ari]! I'm so glad you could make it to our meeting!

french: Mais nous avons refusé d'octroyer à chacun de ses membres un poney pour leur patrouille, j'estime donc que nous sommes gagnants.
russian: Но мы начинали с патрульного пони для каждого члена Драконьей стражи. Так что в моих глазах это победа.
bulgarian: But we negotiated her down from everyone in the Dragonguard getting a patrol pony, so I consider it a win.

english: Maple successfully negotiated an extra snack for the Dragonguard on town clean-up days.
french: Maple a réussi à négocier un encas supplémentaire pour la Garde des dragons les jours de nettoyage de la ville.
russian: Мэйпл успешно выторговала у меня угощение для всей Драконьей стражи в день сдачи находок.
bulgarian: Maple successfully negotiated an extra snack for the Dragonguard on town clean-up days.

english: Those kids! When I told Jo they broke into a council meeting she couldn't stop laughing.
french: Ces gosses ! Quand j'ai raconté à Jo qu'ils avaient débarqué dans une réunion du conseil, elle ne pouvait plus s'arrêter de rire.
russian: Ну и дети! Когда я рассказал Джо, что они вломились на совещание, она так расхохоталась.
bulgarian: Those kids! When I told Jo they broke into a council meeting she couldn't stop laughing.

english: I guess she's growing up!
french: C'est qu'elle grandit !
russian: Моя девочка растёт!
bulgarian: I guess she's growing up!

english: I couldn't be happier about Dell and her friends finally doing something useful with their time for the town.
french: Je suis ravie que Dell et ses amis aient enfin trouvé le moyen d'employer utilement leur temps pour la ville.
russian: Я так довольна, что Делл с друзьями наконец займётся чем-то полезным для города.
bulgarian: I couldn't be happier about Dell and her friends finally doing something useful with their time for the town.

english: You're not going to believe who arrived in town this morning...
french: Tu ne vas jamais croire qui est arrivé en ville, ce matin.
bulgarian: You're not going to believe who arrived in town this morning...

english: I hope you'll excuse the suddenness of our visit.
french: J'espère que vous nous pardonnerez cette visite impromptue.
bulgarian: I hope you'll excuse the suddenness of our visit.

english: There is no need for formalities... you may simply call me Wiscar.
french: Inutile de s'embarrasser de formalités... Tu peux m'appeler tout simplement Wiscar.
bulgarian: There is no need for formalities... you may simply call me Wiscar.

english: Mother, Father, welcome home!
french: Mère, Père, bienvenue à la maison !
bulgarian: Mother, Father, welcome home!

english: But, er... to what do we owe the pleasure?
french: Mais, euh... Que nous vaut le plaisir...?
bulgarian: But, er... to what do we owe the pleasure?

english: We're delighted to see you, of course, it's just that we weren't expecting-
french: Nous sommes ravis de vous voir, bien sûr, seulement nous ne nous attendions pas à...
bulgarian: We're delighted to see you, of course, it's just that we weren't expecting-

english: Patience, my son! There is plenty of time yet for all that.
french: Patience, mon fils ! Nous avons tout le temps pour cela.
bulgarian: Patience, my son! There is plenty of time yet for all that.

english: We were hoping we could take a little time to enjoy the day.
french: Nous espérions profiter un peu de la journée.
bulgarian: We were hoping we could take a little time to enjoy the day.

english: Mistria has changed so much since we first left for the Capital...
french: Mistria a tellement changé depuis que nous en sommes partis pour la capitale...
bulgarian: Mistria has changed so much since we first left for the Capital...

english: If you have the time, why don't you take us on a tour?
french: Si vous en avez le temps, pourquoi ne pas nous faire une petite visite ?
bulgarian: If you have the time, why don't you take us on a tour?

english: You've all worked so hard on Mistria's restoration, after all.
french: Vous avez tous travaillé si dur à la restauration de Mistria, après tout.
bulgarian: You've all worked so hard on Mistria's restoration, after all.

english: It's one thing to hear about the changes in your letters, and another to appreciate them in person!
french: C'est une chose d'entendre parler de tous ces changements dans tes lettres et c'en est une autre de les voir en personne !
bulgarian: It's one thing to hear about the changes in your letters, and another to appreciate them in person!

english: The Baron and Baroness! My parents are here!
french: Le baron et la baronne ! Mes parents sont là !
bulgarian: The Baron and Baroness! My parents are here!

english: Of course, Mother, we would be happy to!
french: Bien sûr, Mère, nous en serions ravis !
bulgarian: Of course, Mother, we would be happy to!

english: I must admit, I am nearly lost for words!
french: Je dois reconnaître que j'en reste presque sans voix !
bulgarian: I must admit, I am nearly lost for words!

english: I can hardly believe how wonderful the town is looking!
french: J'ai du mal à réaliser combien la ville est belle !
bulgarian: I can hardly believe how wonderful the town is looking!

english: I was about to say the same!
french: J'allais dire la même chose.
bulgarian: I was about to say the same!

english: It's clear how hard you've worked for Mistria's sake.
french: Il est évident que vous avez travaillé très dur pour Mistria.
bulgarian: It's clear how hard you've worked for Mistria's sake.

english: I'm so proud of you all!
french: Je suis tellement fier de vous tous !
bulgarian: I'm so proud of you all!

english: Oh well, it was really all [Ari] and Adeline-
french: Oh, eh bien, c'est surtout à [Ari] et Adeline que l'on...
bulgarian: Oh well, it was really all [Ari] and Adeline-

english: That's not true, Eiland...
french: Ce n'est pas vrai, Eiland...
bulgarian: That's not true, Eiland...

english: Your work with [Ari] at the Museum played a huge role in raising our $Town Rank$!
french: Le travail que tu as accompli avec [Ari] au musée a aussi beaucoup contribué à faire monter Mistria au $classement des villes$ !
bulgarian: Your work with [Ari] at the Museum played a huge role in raising our $Town Rank$!

english: Ah!
french: Ah !
bulgarian: Ah!

english: They said they've come with news from the Capital. Isn't this exciting?
french: Ils m'ont dit qu'ils arrivaient avec des nouvelles de la capitale. C'est formidable, non ?
bulgarian: They said they've come with news from the Capital. Isn't this exciting?

english: The $Town$-
french: Le $classement$...
bulgarian: The $Town$-

english: $Rank$...
french: $des villes$...
bulgarian: $Rank$...

english: We were enjoying ourselves so much, we nearly forgot why we came out here in the first place!
french: Nous passions un si bon moment que nous avons failli oublier la raison initiale de notre venue !
bulgarian: We were enjoying ourselves so much, we nearly forgot why we came out here in the first place!

english: Not to worry!
french: Ce n'est rien de grave !
bulgarian: Not to worry!

english: Why don't we just get started now?
french: Si nous commencions tout de suite ?
bulgarian: Why don't we just get started now?

french: Nous avons une grande nouvelle à vous annoncer, voyez-vous.
bulgarian: We have a big announcement to make, you see.

english: One we'd like the whole town to hear.
french: Et nous aimerions que tous les habitants l'entendent.
bulgarian: One we'd like the whole town to hear.

english: Would you three help us gather everyone?
french: Pourriez-vous nous aider à rassembler tout le monde ?
bulgarian: Would you three help us gather everyone?

english: Thank you all for coming on such short notice!
french: Merci à tous d'être venus au pied levé !
bulgarian: Thank you all for coming on such short notice!

english: It does my heart wonders to see you all again.
french: Mon cœur se réjouit de tous vous voir à nouveau.
bulgarian: It does my heart wonders to see you all again.

english: Come on, they're waiting for us just up the road!
french: Viens, ils nous attendent tout près d'ici !
bulgarian: Come on, they're waiting for us just up the road!

english: Salutations, My Lord, My lady!
french: Je vous salue, Messire, Madame !
bulgarian: Salutations, My Lord, My lady!

english: Welcome home, dears!
french: Bienvenue à la maison, mes chers !
bulgarian: Welcome home, dears!

english: It's about time you came back for a visit! We've missed you!
french: Il était temps que vous reveniez nous rendre visite ! Vous nous avez manqué !
bulgarian: It's about time you came back for a visit! We've missed you!

english: Now, I'm sure you must be wondering about the news we've come to share.
french: Bien, je suis certaine que vous vous demandez la raison de notre venue.
bulgarian: Now, I'm sure you must be wondering about the news we've come to share.

english: As you know, Mistria has quickly exceeded all expectations with its achievement of $Diamond Star Town Rank$...
french: Comme vous le savez, Mistria a rapidement dépassé toutes les attentes en parvenant au rang d'$étoile de diamant$...
bulgarian: As you know, Mistria has quickly exceeded all expectations with its achievement of $Diamond Star Town Rank$...

english: The highest honor awarded by the Kingdom's $Renown$ system!
french: Il s'agit de la plus haute récompense qu'offre le système de $renommée$ du royaume !
bulgarian: The highest honor awarded by the Kingdom's $Renown$ system!

english: That is, until now.
french: Du moins, jusqu'à aujourd'hui.
bulgarian: That is, until now.

english: The moment we have all been waiting for has finally arrived.
french: Le moment que nous attendions tous est enfin arrivé.
bulgarian: The moment we have all been waiting for has finally arrived.

english: We are incredibly honored and delighted to announce...
french: Nous avons l'incroyable honneur et l'immense plaisir de vous annoncer...
bulgarian: We are incredibly honored and delighted to announce...

english: By the King's royal decree...
french: Que par décret royal...
bulgarian: By the King's royal decree...

english: A new $Town Rank$ has been created especially for Mistria, which now sits at the top position in the Kingdom!
french: Un nouveau $rang$ a été créé spécialement pour Mistria, qui occupe désormais la première place du classement !
bulgarian: A new $Town Rank$ has been created especially for Mistria, which now sits at the top position in the Kingdom!

english: Congratulations on your achievement of $Mistril Star Town Rank$!
french: Félicitations ! La ville a décroché l'$Étoile de mistril$ !
bulgarian: Congratulations on your achievement of $Mistril Star Town Rank$!

english: And in recognition of [Ari]'s role in Mistria's rapid ascension-
french: De plus, en reconnaissance du rôle joué par [Ari] dans l'ascension fulgurante de Mistria...
bulgarian: And in recognition of [Ari]'s role in Mistria's rapid ascension-

english: King Kelinien has prepared a special award just for <he>him</he><she>her</she><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none>.
french: Le roi Kelinien a préparé une récompense spéciale<he> rien que pour lui</he><she> rien que pour elle</she><they>qui lui est exclusivement réservée</they>.
bulgarian: King Kelinien has prepared a special award just for <he>him</he><she>her</she><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none>.

english: Presenting the $Mistril Star Trophy$!
french: Voici le $trophée Étoile de Mistril$ !
bulgarian: Presenting the $Mistril Star Trophy$!

english: Congratulations, [Ari]!
french: Félicitations, [Ari] !
bulgarian: Congratulations, [Ari]!

english: Congratulations!
french: Félicitations !
bulgarian: Congratulations!

english: We thank you for all that you have done for this town and its people.
french: Nous te remercions de tout ce que tu as fait pour cette ville et ses habitants.
bulgarian: We thank you for all that you have done for this town and its people.

english: You're a true Mistrian, through and through!
french: Tu es <he>un vrai mistrien</he><she>une vraie mistrienne</she><they>chez toi à Mistria</they>, aucun doute là-dessus !
bulgarian: You're a true Mistrian, through and through!

english: Hear hear!
french: Bravo, bravo !
bulgarian: Hear hear!

english: Hear hear!
french: Bravo, bravo !
bulgarian: Hear hear!

english: Greetings, [Ari]!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] !
bulgarian: Greetings, [Ari]!

english: Ah! You must be [Ari].
french: Ah ! Tu dois être [Ari].
bulgarian: Ah! You must be [Ari].

english: It's so good to see you again!
french: Quel plaisir de te revoir !
bulgarian: It's so good to see you again!

english: We've heard so much about you!
french: Nous avons tant entendu parler de toi !
bulgarian: We've heard so much about you!

english: We've been meaning to pay another visit since the wedding, but things have been quite busy at court as of late.
french: Nous voulions vous rendre visite après le mariage, mais nous avons eu fort à faire à la cour, ces derniers temps.
bulgarian: We've been meaning to pay another visit since the wedding, but things have been quite busy at court as of late.

english: I am Baroness Linnet, Eiland and Adeline's mother.
french: Je suis la baronne Linnet, la mère d'Eiland et d'Adeline.
bulgarian: I am Baroness Linnet, Eiland and Adeline's mother.

english: Indeed they have!
french: Absolument !
bulgarian: Indeed they have!

english: It's a pleasure to finally meet you, [Ari].
french: C'est un plaisir de faire enfin ta connaissance, [Ari].
bulgarian: It's a pleasure to finally meet you, [Ari].

english: Though from what I hear, the same is true of Mistria.
french: Mais si j'en crois ce que l'on dit, il en est allé de même à Mistria.
bulgarian: Though from what I hear, the same is true of Mistria.

english: As you may have guessed, I am their father, Baron Wiscar.
french: Comme tu l'auras deviné, je suis leur père, le baron Wiscar.
bulgarian: As you may have guessed, I am their father, Baron Wiscar.

english: [Ari]! I was just on my way to get you!
french: [Ari] ! Je venais te chercher !
bulgarian: [Ari]! I was just on my way to get you!

english: Now don't belabor the point Henrietta! You know these things can't move quickly.
french: Arrête de toujours revenir là-dessus, Henrietta ! Tu sais que ça prend du temps.
russian: Не надо зацикливаться на теме, Генриетта! Ты же знаешь, подобные решения принимаются небыстро.
bulgarian: Now don't belabor the point Henrietta! You know these things can't move quickly.

english: Why, that'd be a dream come true! Just think of the possibilities!
french: Eh ben, ça serait le rêve ! Imaginez les possibilités !
russian: Да это была бы просто мечта! Столько зверей можно было бы заселить!
bulgarian: Why, that'd be a dream come true! Just think of the possibilities!

english: Sheep and horses... heck, maybe even rabbits!
french: Des moutons, des chevaux... et peut-être même des lapins !
russian: Овцы, лошади... да что там, может, даже кролики!
bulgarian: Sheep and horses... heck, maybe even rabbits!

english: All with their own valuable produce! We could turn the products Mistria currently has to import into valuable exports.
french: Qui deviendraient de précieuses marchandises. Nous pourrions exporter plein de produits que Mistria doit importer actuellement.
russian: И все дают ценные фермерские продукты! Вместо того, чтобы ввозить их в Мистрию, мы могли бы наладить прибыльный экспорт.
bulgarian: All with their own valuable produce! We could turn the products Mistria currently has to import into valuable exports.

english: And just imagine how cute they'd all be!
french: Sans compter que ça serait trop mignon, tous ces animaux différents !
russian: И представляете, какие они будут миленькие!
bulgarian: And just imagine how cute they'd all be!

english: Don't think for a minute I'd leave you out of this, [Ari]. Any new animals I start raising I'll make available to you as well.
french: Mais ne va pas croire que je garderai tout pour moi, [Ari]. Tous les animaux que j'élèverai seront également disponibles pour toi.
russian: Только не подумай, что я с тобой не поделюсь, [Ari]. Все новые животные, которых я начну разводить, будут доступны и тебе.
bulgarian: Don't think for a minute I'd leave you out of this, [Ari]. Any new animals I start raising I'll make available to you as well.

english: I'm just happy to help!
french: Si je peux aider, ça me suffit.
russian: Я просто хочу помочь!
bulgarian: I'm just happy to help!

english: Add ducks to the list and you can count me in.
french: Ajoute des canards à ta liste et tu peux compter sur moi.
russian: Внесите в список уток, тогда я в деле.
bulgarian: Add ducks to the list and you can count me in.

english: You're an inspiration, [Ari]!
french: Tout le monde devrait prendre exemple sur toi, [Ari] !
russian: Ты просто образец для подражания, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You're an inspiration, [Ari]!

english: What do you think, Henrietta? You'd need to share the coop.
french: Qu'en dis-tu, Henrietta ? Tu devras partager le poulailler.
russian: Что думаешь, Генриетта? Придётся делить с ними вольер.
bulgarian: What do you think, Henrietta? You'd need to share the coop.

english: (Henrietta seems to think about it for a moment before nodding her head)
french: (Henrietta semble réfléchir quelques instants avant d'acquiescer.)
russian: (Генриетта некоторое время раздумывает, а затем кивает.)
bulgarian: (Henrietta seems to think about it for a moment before nodding her head)

english: It's a deal!
french: C'est d'accord !
russian: Значит, решили!
bulgarian: It's a deal!

english: This is no small upgrade, though.
french: En revanche, nous ne parlons pas d'une petite extension.
russian: Но улучшение потребуется немаленькое.
bulgarian: This is no small upgrade, though.

english: Thanks for coming, [Ari]! I'm very excited to share my latest proposal with you two.
french: Merci d'être venu<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they>, [Ari] ! Je suis impatiente de vous soumettre ma dernière proposition, à tous les deux.
russian:
Спасибо, что

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло, [Ari]! Спешу поделиться с вами своим новым предложением.
bulgarian: Thanks for coming, [Ari]! I'm very excited to share my latest proposal with you two.

english: [Ari], you'll need to gather $400 Wood$, $500 Stone$, $8 Iron Ingots$, and $4000t$. I'll put the $Donation Box$ next to Hayden's barn.
french: [Ari], il nous faudra $400 rondins de bois$, $500 pierres$, $8 lingots de fer$ et $4 000 tesserae$. Je place la $boîte de dons$ à l'extérieur de la grange d'Hayden.
russian: [Ari], тебе надо собрать $400 древесины$, $500 камня$, $8 слитков железа$ и $4000 тессер$. Я поставлю $ящик для пожертвований$ возле хлева Хейдена.
bulgarian: [Ari], you'll need to gather $400 Wood$, $500 Stone$, $8 Iron Ingots$, and $4000t$. I'll put the $Donation Box$ next to Hayden's barn.

english: I know this is asking a lot of both of you, but if we all work together, Mistria's future will be even brighter!
french: Je sais que je vous en demande beaucoup, mais si nous travaillons tous ensemble, je suis certaine que l'avenir de Mistria sera encore plus radieux.
russian: Понимаю, что это серьёзный запрос к вам обоим. Но, работая вместе, мы сможем обеспечить Мистрии светлое будущее!
bulgarian: I know this is asking a lot of both of you, but if we all work together, Mistria's future will be even brighter!

english: I've been excited since I got your letter! The new General Store has been the talk of the town.
french: Dès que j'ai reçu ta lettre, j'ai eu envie d'en savoir plus ! Tout le monde ne parle que du magasin général depuis qu'il a fait peau neuve.
russian: Я всё жду, что ты расскажешь, с тех пор, как получил письмо! Все только и говорят об обновлённом универмаге.
bulgarian: I've been excited since I got your letter! The new General Store has been the talk of the town.

english: But I can't think of what we could do around this old farm that'd match...
french: En revanche, je ne vois pas trop ce qu'on pourrait faire d'approchant avec cette vieille ferme...
russian: Но я даже не представляю, как можно сделать что-то подобное на моей старой ферме...
bulgarian: But I can't think of what we could do around this old farm that'd match...

english: What if you started selling new kinds of animals?
french: Et si tu vendais de nouvelles espèces d'animaux ?
russian: Может, тебе стоит открыть продажу других животных?
bulgarian: What if you started selling new kinds of animals?

english: Advanced chicken training. Better eggs, faster laying times!
french: Pourquoi pas un centre d'entraînement pour les poules ? Des œufs de meilleure qualité et plus souvent !
russian: Продвинутая подготовка кур. Улучшить яйца, сократить время кладки!
bulgarian: Advanced chicken training. Better eggs, faster laying times!

english: How did you guess, [Ari]? Maybe I should start running my plans by you first!
french: Comment tu as deviné, [Ari] ? Je devrais peut-être te soumettre mes propositions en premier !

Как ты

догадались

догадаласьдогадалсядогадалось, [Ari]? Может, мне стоит обсуждать предварительные идеи с тобой!
bulgarian: How did you guess, [Ari]? Maybe I should start running my plans by you first!

english: (Henrietta makes a loud cluck. She seems to be saying bring it on)
french: (Henrietta caquette bruyamment. Elle semble être prête à relever le défi.)
russian: (Генриетта громко кудахчет. Кажется, она хочет сказать: давай, попробуй!)
bulgarian: (Henrietta makes a loud cluck. She seems to be saying bring it on)

english: No one in Mistria knows more about animals than you, Hayden. Well, [Ari] might be a close second.
french: Hayden, tu es celui qui s'y connaît le mieux en animaux à Mistria. Même si [Ari] n'arrive pas loin derrière.
russian: Во всей Мистрии никто не знает о животных больше, чем ты, Хейден. Возможно, [Ari] на втором месте с небольшим отрывом.
bulgarian: No one in Mistria knows more about animals than you, Hayden. Well, [Ari] might be a close second.

english: Aw shucks. I don't like to brag, but I do try to do my best by them. Not sure I could fit additional livestock here though...

russian: Да брось. Не хочу хвастаться, но я стараюсь давать им самое лучшее. И всё же я не уверен, что смогу уместить на ферме больше скота...
bulgarian: Aw shucks. I don't like to brag, but I do try to do my best by them. Not sure I could fit additional livestock here though...

english: What if we built you a larger barn and coop, ones big enough to accommodate all kinds of new animals?
french: Et si nous construisions une grange et un poulailler plus grands, pour accueillir plein de nouveaux animaux ?
russian: А если мы построим тебе более просторные хлев и вольер, чтобы ты смог разводить самых разных животных?
bulgarian: What if we built you a larger barn and coop, ones big enough to accommodate all kinds of new animals?

english: Grain rates are determined by the king's high council, but you make a compelling argument about a sliding scale for imports, Henrietta.
french: Le haut conseil du roi fixe le cours du grain, mais ton idée d'un barème dégressif pour les importations est sensée, Henrietta.

bulgarian: Grain rates are determined by the king's high council, but you make a compelling argument about a sliding scale for imports, Henrietta.

english: I can't wait for the new animals to arrive!
french: J'ai hâte de voir tous ces nouveaux animaux.
russian: Так хочется, чтобы поскорее появились новые животные!
bulgarian: I can't wait for the new animals to arrive!

english: I've been dreaming of growing Mistria's economy with new exports ever since I was a little girl.
french: Toute petite déjà, je rêvais de développer l'économie de Mistria en exportant de nouveaux produits.

bulgarian: I've been dreaming of growing Mistria's economy with new exports ever since I was a little girl.

english: We could set the entire market on its head!
french: Ce serait une occasion en or de renverser le marché !
russian: Мы сможем перевернуть весь рынок!
bulgarian: We could set the entire market on its head!

english: Hayden let slip Adeline's little plan. Do you know how much a thoroughbred Aldarian race horse sells for?
french: Hayden n'a pas su tenir sa langue, il m'a parlé du petit projet d'Adeline. Tu sais quel prix peut atteindre un pur-sang aldarien ?
russian: Хейден слегка проговорился о плане Аделины. А ты знаешь, сколько стоит чистокровная альдарийская скаковая лошадь?
bulgarian: Hayden let slip Adeline's little plan. Do you know how much a thoroughbred Aldarian race horse sells for?

english: Henrietta's been quizzing me!
french: Henrietta me bombarde de questions !
russian: Генриетта проводит мне тесты!
bulgarian: Henrietta's been quizzing me!

english: I've been familiarizing myself with all the new animals I'll have in stock after the upgrade is done.
french: J'ai commencé à me renseigner sur les nouveaux animaux qui arriveront, une fois l'extension terminée.
russian: Я начал изучать новых животных, которые у меня появятся после улучшения.
bulgarian: I've been familiarizing myself with all the new animals I'll have in stock after the upgrade is done.

english: Then told me he could handle the actual building part.
french: Et puis, il m'a dit qu'il se chargerait aussi de la construction.
russian: А затем сказал, что само строительство он может провести и один.
bulgarian: Then told me he could handle the actual building part.

english: Who does he think built Hayden's barn in the first place?!
french: Il ne s'est pas demandé qui avait bâti la première grange d'Hayden.
russian: А кто же, по его мнению, построил нынешний хлев Хейдена?!
bulgarian: Who does he think built Hayden's barn in the first place?!

english: Ryis came asking me for advice about constructing the most "state of the art barn" in the whole country...
french: Ryis est venu me voir. Il voulait savoir ce qu'il fallait pour concevoir « la grange la plus sophistiquée » de tout le pays...
russian: Риз подошёл ко мне спросить совета, как построить хлев «высочайшего уровня во всей стране»...
bulgarian: Ryis came asking me for advice about constructing the most "state of the art barn" in the whole country...

english: I appreciate hearing that from you, Landen.
french: Venant de toi, ça me fait très plaisir, Landen.
russian: От тебя приятно это слышать, Ланден.
bulgarian: I appreciate hearing that from you, Landen.

english: Would you look at that, Henrietta!
french: Regarde un peu ça, Henrietta !
russian: Взгляни, Генриетта!
bulgarian: Would you look at that, Henrietta!

english: Haha, I think we've got her seal of approval.
french: Ha ha, j'ai l'impression qu'elle a donné son accord.
russian: Ха-ха, по-моему, она довольна нашей работой.
bulgarian: Haha, I think we've got her seal of approval.

english: That was fun! You and [Ari] are shaping up into fine carpenters.
french: C'était un plaisir ! [Ari] et toi, vous êtes devenus très bons en menuiserie.
russian: Славно поработали! И ты и [Ari] можете стать превосходными плотниками.
bulgarian: That was fun! You and [Ari] are shaping up into fine carpenters.

english: Thanks. Maybe next time Adeline has a big project for us, you could join in from the start.
french: Merci. La prochaine fois qu'Adeline nous proposera un gros projet, tu pourrais y participer dès le début, non ?
russian: Спасибо. Может, в следующий раз, когда у Аделины будет для нас крупный проект, ты сможешь присоединиться сразу?
bulgarian: Thanks. Maybe next time Adeline has a big project for us, you could join in from the start.

english: I'd like that.
french: J'aimerais beaucoup.
russian: С удовольствием.
bulgarian: I'd like that.

english: Thank you all! And now the real work begins for you, Hayden.
french: Un grand merci ! C'est là que commence le plus dur pour toi, Hayden.
russian: Спасибо всем! А для тебя, Хейден, работа только начинается.
bulgarian: Thank you all! And now the real work begins for you, Hayden.

english: And I can't wait! Time to get the new animals settled.
french: J'attendais ça avec impatience ! Il est temps d'installer les nouveaux animaux.
russian: Жду не дождусь! Пора заселять новых животных.
bulgarian: And I can't wait! Time to get the new animals settled.

english: You come on by any time you like for your own, [Ari]!
french: Tu passes quand tu veux choisir le tien, [Ari] !
russian: А ты, [Ari], можешь зайти и взять их себе, когда захочешь!
bulgarian: You come on by any time you like for your own, [Ari]!

english: Uncle, really. [Ari] and I have got this. Aren't you supposed to be retired?
french: Oncle Landen, [Ari] et moi, on va s'en occuper. Tu n'es pas censé être à la retraite ?
russian: Ну правда, дядя. [Ari] и я можем справиться вдвоём. Разве ты не на пенсии?
bulgarian: Uncle, really. [Ari] and I have got this. Aren't you supposed to be retired?

english: What a thing to say! Me? Retired?
french: Balivernes ! Retraité ? Moi ?
russian: Что за ерунда! Я? На пенсии?
bulgarian: What a thing to say! Me? Retired?

english: Many hands make light work!
french: À plusieurs, le travail avance plus vite.
russian: Вместе дело спорится!
bulgarian: Many hands make light work!

english: I'm sure Landen can pitch in while we do the heavy lifting.
french: Landen s'occupera des finitions pendant qu'on gérera le gros œuvre.
russian: Я не против, если мы возьмём тяжёлую работу, а Ланден будет помогать.
bulgarian: I'm sure Landen can pitch in while we do the heavy lifting.

english: See? [Ari] gets it.
french: Tu vois ? [Ari] a tout compris.
russian: Видишь? Вот [Ari] меня понимает.
bulgarian: See? [Ari] gets it.

english: Now you listen here-
french: Alors, tu m'écoutes bien...
russian: Так что послушай меня...
bulgarian: Now you listen here-

english: Landen, we are honored to have someone with your decades of experience so generously lending us your aid. Right, Hayden?
french: Landen, nous sommes très heureux d'avoir les conseils d'un professionnel avec plusieurs décennies d'expérience. Pas vrai, Hayden ?
russian: Ланден, мы очень благодарны, что ты готов поделиться с нами своим многолетним опытом. Для нас это большая честь, да, Хейден?
bulgarian: Landen, we are honored to have someone with your decades of experience so generously lending us your aid. Right, Hayden?

english: Oh, absolutely!
french: Oh, tout à fait !
russian: О, безусловно!
bulgarian: Oh, absolutely!

english: That's more like it! Come on you two, let's get to work.
french: Je préfère ça ! Allez, venez vous deux, nous avons du pain sur la planche.
russian: Вот это я и хотел услышать! Пойдёмте, ребята, за работу.
bulgarian: That's more like it! Come on you two, let's get to work.

english: Yes, Uncle.
french: D'accord, oncle Landen.
russian: Хорошо, дядя.
bulgarian: Yes, Uncle.

english: This barn sure takes me back. You've kept my work in great condition, Hayden!
french: Cette grange me rappelle bien des souvenirs. Elle est encore très belle. Tu l'as très bien entretenue, Hayden !
russian: Этот хлев вызывает такую ностальгию. Вижу, ты содержишь мою работу в отличном виде, Хейден!
bulgarian: This barn sure takes me back. You've kept my work in great condition, Hayden!

english: I've got even bigger plans, just you wait and see!
french: J'ai des projets encore plus importants, tu verras !
russian: У меня есть и более грандиозные планы. Погоди — ещё узнаешь!
bulgarian: I've got even bigger plans, just you wait and see!

english: Isn't it wonderful how much Mistria has grown? But we can't rest on our laurels yet!
french: C'est incroyable comme Mistria s'est développé ? Enfin, pas question de nous reposer sur nos lauriers !
russian: Мистрия так выросла — просто чудеса! Но ещё не время почивать на лаврах!
bulgarian: Isn't it wonderful how much Mistria has grown? But we can't rest on our laurels yet!

english: Have you just been repaying me back for those turnip seeds I gave you when you moved in?
french: C'est ta façon de me remercier pour les semis de navet que je t'ai offerts à ton arrivée ?
russian:
Ты до сих пор расплачиваешься со мной за семена репы, которые я тебе подарил, когда ты

приехали

приехалаприехалприехало?
bulgarian: Have you just been repaying me back for those turnip seeds I gave you when you moved in?

english: Gya ha ha!
french: Gah ha ha !
russian: Га-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Gya ha ha!

english: I really can't thank you enough, [Ari]. Repairing the bridge, then the Mill, and now the new barn and coop...
french: Je ne sais pas comment te remercier, [Ari]. Tu as retapé le pont, puis le moulin. Maintenant, la grange et le poulailler...
russian: Я тебе бесконечно благодарен, [Ari]. Сначала ремонт моста, потом мельница, а теперь ещё хлев и вольер...
bulgarian: I really can't thank you enough, [Ari]. Repairing the bridge, then the Mill, and now the new barn and coop...

english: (Henrietta seems to be thanking you for the new coop)
french: (On dirait qu'Henrietta vous remercie pour le nouveau poulailler.)
russian: (Кажется, Генриетта благодарит вас за новый вольер.)
bulgarian: (Henrietta seems to be thanking you for the new coop)

english: To take help from me when I offer it! Hahaha!
french: C'est d'accepter mon aide quand je la lui propose ! Ha ha ha !
russian: Принимать мою помощь, когда я предлагаю! Ха-ха-ха!
bulgarian: To take help from me when I offer it! Hahaha!

english: Don't get me wrong. I'm happy to let Ryis take over the family business, but he's still got to learn one important lesson...
french: Ne te méprends pas sur ce que je vais dire. Ryis a repris l'affaire familiale, mais il lui reste une grande leçon à apprendre...
russian: Не подумай плохого, я с радостью передам семейное дело Ризу. Но он ещё не усвоил один важный урок...
bulgarian: Don't get me wrong. I'm happy to let Ryis take over the family business, but he's still got to learn one important lesson...

english: Hayden is going to be so excited! Let's gather everyone up.
french: Hayden va être très ému ! Faisons venir tout le monde.
russian: Как же Хейден обрадуется! Давай всех соберём.
bulgarian: Hayden is going to be so excited! Let's gather everyone up.

english: Beautiful out here, isn't it?
french: C'est magnifique ici, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Красивый тут вид, да?
bulgarian: Beautiful out here, isn't it?

english: That's true!
french: Absolument !
russian: Это верно!
bulgarian: That's true!

english: I'll set out a $Donation Box$. I think $300 Wood$, $150 Stone$, $50 Fiber$ and then $1000t$ delivered to Terithia should cover it.
french: Je vais installer une $boîte de dons$. Je pense que $300 rondins de bois$, $150 pierres$, $50 poignées de fibre$ et $1 000 tesserae$, le tout livré à Terithia, devraient suffire.
russian: Я поставлю $ящик для пожертвований$. Думаю, если принесёшь Теризии $300 древесины$, $150 камня$, $50 волокна$ и $1000 тессер$, этого должно хватить.
bulgarian: I'll set out a $Donation Box$. I think $300 Wood$, $150 Stone$, $50 Fiber$ and then $1000t$ delivered to Terithia should cover it.

english: I'll work with Ryis on some blueprints.
french: Je vais discuter des plans avec Ryis.
russian: Я поговорю с Ризом насчёт чертежей.
bulgarian: I'll work with Ryis on some blueprints.

english: There's a lot to love here in Mistria, but I personally think nothing beats our beach!
french: Il y a beaucoup d'endroits très beaux à Mistria, mais personnellement, c'est notre plage que je préfère !
russian: В Мистрии много хороших мест, но мне лично больше всего по душе пляж.
bulgarian: There's a lot to love here in Mistria, but I personally think nothing beats our beach!

english: You picked the perfect spot to build a house, Terithia.
french: Tu as vraiment choisi le lieu idéal pour ta maison, Terithia.
russian: Тогда ты выбрала идеальное место для дома, Теризия.
bulgarian: You picked the perfect spot to build a house, Terithia.

english: Funny thing though... it's even nicer on that little island to the west of here.
french: C'est vrai, mais tu sais... la petite île à l'ouest d'ici est encore plus agréable.
russian: Но вот что любопытно... на том островке к западу ещё более отличное местечко.
bulgarian: Funny thing though... it's even nicer on that little island to the west of here.

english: I remember! Before the earthquake destroyed the bridge, it was a great spot for $Fishing$ and $Foraging$. Also, it's really pretty!
french: Je m'en souviens ! C'était l'endroit rêvé pour la $pêche$ et la $cueillette$, sans compter que c'était très joli. Malheureusement, le tremblement de terre a détruit le pont pour y accéder.
russian: Я помню! До землетрясения, когда у нас ещё был мост, там можно было $ловить рыбу$ и $собирать растения$. И ещё там очень красиво!
bulgarian: I remember! Before the earthquake destroyed the bridge, it was a great spot for $Fishing$ and $Foraging$. Also, it's really pretty!

english: I sometimes take my boat past there, and it still has all those things!
french: Je m'y rends parfois en bateau, et je peux te garantir que l'île n'a rien perdu de son charme !
russian: Иногда я проплываю мимо него на лодке и вижу, что всё это никуда не делось!
bulgarian: I sometimes take my boat past there, and it still has all those things!

english: So I thought, why not share it again with the rest of the town?
french: C'est pour ça que je me suis dit que ce serait sympa d'en faire à nouveau profiter les autres habitants.
russian: Так что я подумала: почему бы не поделиться идеей с остальными жителями?
bulgarian: So I thought, why not share it again with the rest of the town?

english: What do you think, [Ari]?
french: Qu'en penses-tu, [Ari] ?
russian: Что думаешь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: What do you think, [Ari]?

english: More beach sounds like a win to me!
french: La plage, je suis toujours pour !
russian: Больше пляжа — всегда к лучшему!
bulgarian: More beach sounds like a win to me!

english: Well, I have some experience with bridges...
french: Eh bien, j'ai une certaine expérience des ponts...
russian: Что ж, у меня уже есть опыт в строительстве мостов...
bulgarian: Well, I have some experience with bridges...

english: Me too!
french: Moi aussi !
russian: Я тоже так думаю!
bulgarian: Me too!

english: Hey, [Ari]!
french: Salut, [Ari] !
russian: Привет, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]!

english: Stone pillars, wooden slats, and rope to tie it all together! Easy to replace if anything starts to wear out.
french: Des piliers de pierre et des lattes de bois, le tout maintenu par des cordages ! Chaque pièce peut se remplacer facilement si elle s'use.
russian: Опоры из камня, дорожка из дерева, и всё связано верёвкой! Всё легко заменяется при износе.
bulgarian: Stone pillars, wooden slats, and rope to tie it all together! Easy to replace if anything starts to wear out.

english: And flexible enough to ride through an earthquake!
french: Et l'ensemble est assez souple pour résister à un tremblement de terre !
russian: А гибкая конструкция может пережить землетрясение!
bulgarian: And flexible enough to ride through an earthquake!

english: We've done a good day's work.
french: On a bien travaillé.
russian: Сегодня мы славно поработали.
bulgarian: We've done a good day's work.

english: Time for island exploration!
french: Il est temps d'aller explorer l'île !
russian: Пора исследовать остров!
bulgarian: Time for island exploration!

english: I'll say!
french: Comme tu dis !
russian: Да уж!
bulgarian: I'll say!

english: Kya ha ha!
french: Hé hé hé !
russian: Кя-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Kya ha ha!

english: I'll pass on the good word to the rest of the town.
french: Je vais annoncer la bonne nouvelle au reste de la ville.
russian: Я передам вести остальным жителям.
bulgarian: I'll pass on the good word to the rest of the town.

english: Wow, you two!
french: Waouh, bravo à vous deux !
russian: Вот это вы молодцы!
bulgarian: Wow, you two!

english: Great! Let's grab Adeline and head to the build site!
french: Parfait ! Allons chercher Adeline et rendons-nous sur place !
russian: Отлично! Пойдём за Аделиной — и к стройплощадке!
bulgarian: Great! Let's grab Adeline and head to the build site!

english: We're ready to start on the Beach Bridge?
french: Tout est prêt pour lancer la construction du pont de la plage ?
russian: Мы готовы приступить к строительству моста?
bulgarian: We're ready to start on the Beach Bridge?

english: I know this seems out of the blue, but I've got such good memories of this $Bell Tower$ from when my family would visit Mistria.
bulgarian: I know this seems out of the blue, but I've got such good memories of this $Bell Tower$ from when my family would visit Mistria.

english: I should have, but it's been one thing after another since the earthquake.
bulgarian: I should have, but it's been one thing after another since the earthquake.

english: Still, let's see what we're working with.
bulgarian: Still, let's see what we're working with.

english: Woodwork could use a refresh... foundation needs to be shored up...
bulgarian: Woodwork could use a refresh... foundation needs to be shored up...

english: The biggest issue is that the Tower's Crystal Resonator is damaged, and I don't have much expertise with them.
bulgarian: The biggest issue is that the Tower's Crystal Resonator is damaged, and I don't have much expertise with them.

english: And here I was hoping for a quick fix...
bulgarian: And here I was hoping for a quick fix...

english: Well, there isn't a particular rush! The bell still rings, don't it?
bulgarian: Well, there isn't a particular rush! The bell still rings, don't it?

english: It's not like it's going to fall over anytime soon.
bulgarian: It's not like it's going to fall over anytime soon.

english: Landen-
bulgarian: Landen-

english: But hey! It sounds like a fun project. I'm happy to donate my labor free of charge! I'll even clear my schedule!
bulgarian: But hey! It sounds like a fun project. I'm happy to donate my labor free of charge! I'll even clear my schedule!

english: Now we're talking!
bulgarian: Now we're talking!

english: Hearing the bell ring out over the town every time evening fell... it was magical.
bulgarian: Hearing the bell ring out over the town every time evening fell... it was magical.

english: However, the recent plaza project used up a lot of the Carpenter's Shops extra stock. I could use some help with the materials...
bulgarian: However, the recent plaza project used up a lot of the Carpenter's Shops extra stock. I could use some help with the materials...

english: What do you say, [Ari]?
bulgarian: What do you say, [Ari]?

english: You can all rely on me!
bulgarian: You can all rely on me!

english: Will the bell still ring at nightfall like this?
bulgarian: Will the bell still ring at nightfall like this?

english: You're the best, [Ari].
bulgarian: You're the best, [Ari].

english: Well, maybe...but who knows what it's going to sound like.
bulgarian: Well, maybe...but who knows what it's going to sound like.

english: We could really use your help, [Ari].
bulgarian: We could really use your help, [Ari].

english: Based on what we talked about... would $20 Refined Stone$ and $30 Hardwood$ be adequate for the building repairs?
bulgarian: Based on what we talked about... would $20 Refined Stone$ and $30 Hardwood$ be adequate for the building repairs?

english: We'll need a $Dragon-Forged Fang$ and a $Dragon-Forged Core$ to fix the Crystal Restonator, too.
bulgarian: We'll need a $Dragon-Forged Fang$ and a $Dragon-Forged Core$ to fix the Crystal Restonator, too.

english: But when it's working again, I can make some upgrades so you can $change the sound of the Bell's toll$!
bulgarian: But when it's working again, I can make some upgrades so you can $change the sound of the Bell's toll$!

english: You'll even be able to $play Sound Crystals in town$, if you'd like. I've already got some really fun melodies in mind.
bulgarian: You'll even be able to $play Sound Crystals in town$, if you'd like. I've already got some really fun melodies in mind.

english: I'll place the $Donation Box$ outside the Bell Tower for you, [Ari]. Come and let me know when you've gathered the materials!
bulgarian: I'll place the $Donation Box$ outside the Bell Tower for you, [Ari]. Come and let me know when you've gathered the materials!

english: I know the bell still works, but I'd really like to help out and get the rest of the tower fixed up!
bulgarian: I know the bell still works, but I'd really like to help out and get the rest of the tower fixed up!

english: That's so inspiring to hear, Zorel! I'm glad you have such fond memories of Mistria.
bulgarian: That's so inspiring to hear, Zorel! I'm glad you have such fond memories of Mistria.

english: The Bell Tower was damaged in the earthquake, but since it remained mostly functional, we made the decision to seal it while we dealt with more urgent repairs.
bulgarian: The Bell Tower was damaged in the earthquake, but since it remained mostly functional, we made the decision to seal it while we dealt with more urgent repairs.

english: Landen, can you give us an update on the Bell Tower's condition?
bulgarian: Landen, can you give us an update on the Bell Tower's condition?

english: Well, I won't lie. It's seen better days!
bulgarian: Well, I won't lie. It's seen better days!

english: What with the earthquake and me retiring, maintenance hasn't been what it should be.
bulgarian: What with the earthquake and me retiring, maintenance hasn't been what it should be.

english: A Bell Tower has a lot of specialized parts, see? My mentor, Old Jacque passed a lot of it down to me, but I haven't had a chance yet to pass it down to Ryis.
bulgarian: A Bell Tower has a lot of specialized parts, see? My mentor, Old Jacque passed a lot of it down to me, but I haven't had a chance yet to pass it down to Ryis.

english: [Ari], you came!
bulgarian: [Ari], you came!

english: I should do a town audit! I don't want another surprise like that.
bulgarian: I should do a town audit! I don't want another surprise like that.

english: I had no idea how bad of shape the Bell Tower had gotten since the earthquake...
bulgarian: I had no idea how bad of shape the Bell Tower had gotten since the earthquake...

english: My mentor Jacque used to go on and on about it. He said it was a marvel of engineering.
bulgarian: My mentor Jacque used to go on and on about it. He said it was a marvel of engineering.

english: He didn't build it, and he didn't know who did. It's been in this town a long, long time.
bulgarian: He didn't build it, and he didn't know who did. It's been in this town a long, long time.

english: Also he'd get real antsy if our repair work didn't wrap up before sunset.
bulgarian: Also he'd get real antsy if our repair work didn't wrap up before sunset.

english: I wonder why...
bulgarian: I wonder why...

english: I'm excited to get back to work on the Bell Tower!
bulgarian: I'm excited to get back to work on the Bell Tower!

english: I'm glad we're finally going to fix it properly, but it's weird how insistent he is that we drop everything to do it as soon as you gather the supplies.
bulgarian: I'm glad we're finally going to fix it properly, but it's weird how insistent he is that we drop everything to do it as soon as you gather the supplies.

english: Landen filled me in on the Bell Tower project.
bulgarian: Landen filled me in on the Bell Tower project.

english: It makes my heart hurt to hear the bell the way it is now.
bulgarian: It makes my heart hurt to hear the bell the way it is now.

english: Thanks again for helping out with the Bell Tower, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thanks again for helping out with the Bell Tower, [Ari].

english: Yeah! Should be an interesting challenge.
bulgarian: Yeah! Should be an interesting challenge.

english: Wonderful work, everyone!
bulgarian: Wonderful work, everyone!

english: And before we go...
bulgarian: And before we go...

english: That's the spirit, just follow my lead!
bulgarian: That's the spirit, just follow my lead!

english: You just sit back and relax, [Ari]! You've done more than enough.
bulgarian: You just sit back and relax, [Ari]! You've done more than enough.

english: Zorel, it's safe to come in and fix the $Crystal Resonator$!
bulgarian: Zorel, it's safe to come in and fix the $Crystal Resonator$!

english: And there we are! Good as new. Better even!
bulgarian: And there we are! Good as new. Better even!

english: Shall we go inside?
bulgarian: Shall we go inside?

english: It's so beautiful in here! I'd forgotten, it's been ages since I've been inside.
bulgarian: It's so beautiful in here! I'd forgotten, it's been ages since I've been inside.

english: Uncle Landen passed down all of his maintenance notes. I'll be able to keep the tower in great condition from now on.
bulgarian: Uncle Landen passed down all of his maintenance notes. I'll be able to keep the tower in great condition from now on.

english: The resonator is fully repaired! I've already put in some $new bell tunes$ if anyone wants to play around with it later.
bulgarian: The resonator is fully repaired! I've already put in some $new bell tunes$ if anyone wants to play around with it later.

english: You ready, Ryis?
bulgarian: You ready, Ryis?

english: It does my heart good to know the Bell Tower will grace Mistria for future generations to enjoy!
bulgarian: It does my heart good to know the Bell Tower will grace Mistria for future generations to enjoy!

english: Maybe I'm not breaking big enough stuff...
bulgarian: Maybe I'm not breaking big enough stuff...

english: Landen sure is lucky. When I break something, my parents don't get a buncha people in town to help ME fix it.
bulgarian: Landen sure is lucky. When I break something, my parents don't get a buncha people in town to help ME fix it.

english: I should make time to talk to him. As an archaeologist, an area's oral traditions can tell us quite a lot that would otherwise be missed.
bulgarian: I should make time to talk to him. As an archaeologist, an area's oral traditions can tell us quite a lot that would otherwise be missed.

english: Ryis mentioned that Landen had quite a few tall tales to tell him about the Bell Tower.
bulgarian: Ryis mentioned that Landen had quite a few tall tales to tell him about the Bell Tower.

english: Thanks again for the supplies, [Ari]. You really did me a solid!
bulgarian: Thanks again for the supplies, [Ari]. You really did me a solid!

english: Can't tell you how glad I am that the Bell Tower is back to the way it should be.
bulgarian: Can't tell you how glad I am that the Bell Tower is back to the way it should be.

english: Frankly, I've never seen another building like it.
bulgarian: Frankly, I've never seen another building like it.

english: I can see why my Uncle held off on teaching me about the Bell Tower's repair.
bulgarian: I can see why my Uncle held off on teaching me about the Bell Tower's repair.

english: It's nice to think my melodies will sound out over Mistria from now on.
bulgarian: It's nice to think my melodies will sound out over Mistria from now on.

english: The bell's sounding great now, huh?
bulgarian: The bell's sounding great now, huh?

english: You're the best, [Ari]! Let's go get everyone!
bulgarian: You're the best, [Ari]! Let's go get everyone!

english: All the materials are ready for the Bell Tower?
bulgarian: All the materials are ready for the Bell Tower?

english: Adeline, you know I'm up for it, but this... is a big project.
french: Adeline, tu sais que je te suis à fond, mais... c'est un gros projet.
russian: Аделина, ты знаешь, я только за, но это... такой крупный проект.
bulgarian: Adeline, you know I'm up for it, but this... is a big project.

english: Gathering materials locally would definitely speed things up!
french: Rassembler des matériaux au niveau local accélérerait en effet beaucoup les choses !
russian: Если использовать местные материалы, то дело сдвинется с мёртвой точки!
bulgarian: Gathering materials locally would definitely speed things up!

english: That farmland of yours is loaded with high quality stone and timber, [Ari].
french: Le terrain sur lequel se trouve ta ferme est plein de pierres et de bois de construction de très bonne qualité, [Ari].
russian: На твоём участке полным полно камней и древесины высокого качества, [Ari].
bulgarian: That farmland of yours is loaded with high quality stone and timber, [Ari].

english: If you're willing to do the gathering, we can compensate for the materials!
french: Si tu veux bien te charger de récupérer tout ce qu'il nous faut, nous t'indemniserons pour les matériaux !
russian: Если ты сможешь заняться сбором, то мы компенсируем затраты!
bulgarian: If you're willing to do the gathering, we can compensate for the materials!

english: By my calculations... $60 Stone$ and $60 Wood$ should be enough.
french: D'après mes calculs... $60 pierres$ et $60 rondins de bois$ devraient faire l'affaire.
russian: По моим подсчётам... $60 камня$ и $60 древесины$ должно хватить.
bulgarian: By my calculations... $60 Stone$ and $60 Wood$ should be enough.

english: Sounds right to me!
french: Ça me paraît correct !
russian: Да, по-моему, тоже!
bulgarian: Sounds right to me!

english: With a repaired bridge, we'll be able to get the Saturday Market up and running again!
french: Une fois le pont réparé, nous pourrons relancer le marché du samedi.
russian: Когда мы отремонтируем мост, сможем снова устраивать Субботний базар!
bulgarian: With a repaired bridge, we'll be able to get the Saturday Market up and running again!

english: I'll set up a $Donation Box$ here at the bridge for you to deposit any gathered materials.
french: Je vais installer une $boîte de dons$ à côté du pont pour que tu puisses y déposer les matériaux.
russian: Я поставлю $ящик для пожертвований$ возле моста. Складывай собранные материалы туда.
bulgarian: I'll set up a $Donation Box$ here at the bridge for you to deposit any gathered materials.

english: Come talk to me when you're finished, and we'll begin the repairs!
french: Viens me voir quand tu auras terminé et nous lancerons les réparations.
russian: Подойди ко мне, когда всё соберёшь, и мы начнём ремонт!
bulgarian: Come talk to me when you're finished, and we'll begin the repairs!

english: We're counting on you!
french: Nous comptons sur toi !
russian: Мы на тебя рассчитываем!
bulgarian: We're counting on you!

english: You can rely on me to keep Mistria supplied with the basics until the construction is done, but I can't work miracles.
french: Tu peux compter sur moi pour que Mistria ne manque d'aucun produit de base d'ici la fin des travaux, mais je ne peux pas faire de miracles.
russian: Я могу обеспечивать Мистрию базовыми продуктами, пока идёт стройка. Но я всё-таки не волшебник.
bulgarian: You can rely on me to keep Mistria supplied with the basics until the construction is done, but I can't work miracles.

english: Without the bridge, I can't get my wagon in and out of town. And there's only so much I can carry in on my back.
french: Sans pont, impossible d'aller jusqu'en ville ou d'en partir avec mon chariot. Et il y a des limites à ce que je peux transporter sur mon dos.
russian: Без моста я не могу привезти в город фургон. А на спине много не утащишь.
bulgarian: Without the bridge, I can't get my wagon in and out of town. And there's only so much I can carry in on my back.

english: I've allocated all the resources I can for this, but the earthquake relief from the Capital hasn't been as robust as we'd hoped for...
french: J'ai débloqué toutes les ressources restantes pour ça, mais les aides du fond pour la reconstruction étaient moins importantes qu'espérées...
russian: Я выделила все доступные ресурсы, но столичная помощь пострадавшим от землетрясения оказалась не такой солидной, как мы рассчитывали...
bulgarian: I've allocated all the resources I can for this, but the earthquake relief from the Capital hasn't been as robust as we'd hoped for...

english: I've talked it over with the other merchants in town, we're happy to contribute funds. You've got our backing!
french: J'en ai touché deux mots aux autres commerçants de la ville et tout le monde est d'accord pour mettre de l'argent. Tu peux compter sur nous !
russian: Я поговорила с другими местными торговцами. Мы готовы поделиться средствами. Мы тебя поддержим!
bulgarian: I've talked it over with the other merchants in town, we're happy to contribute funds. You've got our backing!

english: That's wonderful to hear, Nora!
french: C'est merveilleux, Nora !
russian: Какая замечательная новость, Нора!
bulgarian: That's wonderful to hear, Nora!

english: However, with the whole kingdom in dire need of repair materials, we can't afford the inflated prices on the stone and wood we'll need...
french: Malheureusement, le royaume tout entier achète des matériaux pour la reconstruction. Les prix de la pierre et du bois se sont envolés et notre budget n'y suffira pas...
russian: Однако сейчас стройматериалы нужны по всему королевству, и цены на камень и древесину так взмахнули, что они нам не по карману...
bulgarian: However, with the whole kingdom in dire need of repair materials, we can't afford the inflated prices on the stone and wood we'll need...

english: Sounds like it's my time to shine!
french: C'est là que j'entre en jeu !
russian: Кажется, это работа как раз для меня!
bulgarian: Sounds like it's my time to shine!

english: I suppose I could lend a hand...
french: Je suppose que je pourrais donner un coup de main...
russian:
Возможно, я

могли

могламогмогло бы помочь...
bulgarian: I suppose I could lend a hand...

english: Wonderful, [Ari]! I knew you were the right person for the job!
french: C'est fantastique, [Ari] ! Je savais que tu étais la personne toute désignée pour t'occuper de ça !
russian: Чудно, [Ari]! Я знала, что ты сможешь нас выручить!
bulgarian: Wonderful, [Ari]! I knew you were the right person for the job!

english: I knew you were the right person for the job!
french: Je savais que tu étais la personne toute désignée pour t'occuper de ça !
russian: Я знала, что ты сможешь нас выручить!
bulgarian: I knew you were the right person for the job!

english: Hey, [Ari]! We were just getting started.
french: Te voilà, [Ari] ! Nous venons de commencer.
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Мы как раз собирались начинать.
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]! We were just getting started.

english: I've been trying to wrangle promises out of the old Saturday Market merchants to return when we're ready.
french: J'ai fait promettre à quelques commerçants du samedi de revenir quand nous serons à nouveau prêts.
russian: Я уже раздаю обещания торговцам со старого Субботнего базара, чтобы они вернулись, когда мы всё починим.
bulgarian: I've been trying to wrangle promises out of the old Saturday Market merchants to return when we're ready.

english: The sooner the bridge is repaired the better!
french: Plus vite le pont sera réparé, mieux ce sera !
russian: Чем быстрее отремонтируем мост, тем лучше!
bulgarian: The sooner the bridge is repaired the better!

english: [Ari]! Hope the stone and wood collecting is going well.
french: J'espère que tu t'en sors avec les pierres et le bois, [Ari].
russian: [Ari]! Надеюсь, сбор камня и дерева идёт хорошо.
bulgarian: [Ari]! Hope the stone and wood collecting is going well.

english: Don't worry about any iron goods, Adeline already secured everything that Ryis needs from me.
french: Ne t'inquiète pas pour ce qui est des pièces métalliques, Adeline m'a commandé tout ce dont Ryis aura besoin.
russian: О железных деталях не беспокойся. Всё, что нужно Ризу, Аделина уже заказала у меня.
bulgarian: Don't worry about any iron goods, Adeline already secured everything that Ryis needs from me.

english: You'd better be making this your top priority, [Ari].
french: Ce serait bien que tu t'occupes de ça en priorité, [Ari].
russian: Советую отнестись к этому делу серьёзно, [Ari].
bulgarian: You'd better be making this your top priority, [Ari].

english: Heard you're helping out with the broken bridge repairs.
french: Il paraît que tu donnes un coup de main pour la réparation du pont.
russian:
Я слышал, ты

решили

решиларешилрешило помочь с починкой моста.
bulgarian: Heard you're helping out with the broken bridge repairs.

english: Hopefully the new bridge will last even longer!
french: Espérons que le nouveau pont tiendra encore plus longtemps !
russian: Надеюсь, новый мост простоит ещё дольше!
bulgarian: Hopefully the new bridge will last even longer!

english: Eiland told me that the bridge had stood for hundreds of years before the earthquake...
french: Eiland m'a dit que ce pont avait résisté des centaines d'années, jusqu'au tremblement de terre...
russian: Эйланд говорит, это до землетрясения этот мост стоял здесь многие сотни лет...
bulgarian: Eiland told me that the bridge had stood for hundreds of years before the earthquake...

english: Nice work [Ari]! Now it's my turn.
french: Excellent travail, [Ari] ! C'est à moi de jouer, maintenant.
russian: Отличная работа, [Ari]! Теперь мой черёд.
bulgarian: Nice work [Ari]! Now it's my turn.

english: Just let us know how we can help, Ryis.
french: Dis-nous si tu as besoin d'aide, Ryis.
russian: Позови, если надо будет помочь, Риз.
bulgarian: Just let us know how we can help, Ryis.

english: Are we done, Ryis? Feels like we're done.
french: C'est terminé, Ryis ? J'en ai l'impression.
russian: Мы закончили, Риз? Судя по виду, закончили.
bulgarian: Are we done, Ryis? Feels like we're done.

english: We sure are! This bridge is going to last a long, long time.
french: Tout à fait ! Ce pont va durer très très longtemps.
russian: Так точно! Этот мост простоит ещё очень долго.
bulgarian: We sure are! This bridge is going to last a long, long time.

english: Great job, everyone!
french: Beau travail, tout le monde !
russian: Какие вы все молодцы!
bulgarian: Great job, everyone!

english: I'll let the Saturday Market merchants know that the bridge is repaired!
french: Je vais prévenir les vendeurs du samedi que le pont est réparé !
russian: Я расскажу торговцам с Субботнего базара, что наш мост готов!
bulgarian: I'll let the Saturday Market merchants know that the bridge is repaired!

english: Let me help you, Adeline. Together, I'm sure we can guarantee that Saturday will be market day in Mistria again!
french: Laisse-moi t'aider, Adeline. Ensemble, nous referons du samedi le jour du marché à Mistria.
russian: Я тебе помогу, Аделина. Вместе мы точно сможем снова сделать субботу в Мистрии базарным днём!
bulgarian: Let me help you, Adeline. Together, I'm sure we can guarantee that Saturday will be market day in Mistria again!

english: Cheers to that!
french: Bien dit !
russian: Удачи вам!
bulgarian: Cheers to that!

english: It's time! Let's get this bridge repaired.
french: Il est temps de réparer ce pont.
russian: Всё готово! Давайте приступим к починке моста.
bulgarian: It's time! Let's get this bridge repaired.

english: She told me they're going to place a big restock order for the General Store, I hope Balor has enough room in his wagon!
french: Elle m'a dit qu'ils allaient passer une très grosse commande pour refaire les stocks du magasin général. J'espère que Balor aura assez de place dans son chariot.
russian: Она сказала, что они готовят крупный заказ продуктов для универмага. Надеюсь, у Балора в фургоне хватит места!
bulgarian: She told me they're going to place a big restock order for the General Store, I hope Balor has enough room in his wagon!

english: My mom is over the moon about the bridge being repaired, [Ari]!
french: Ma mère est aux anges que le pont ait été réparé, [Ari] !
russian: Моя мама вне себя от счастья после ремонта моста, [Ari].
bulgarian: My mom is over the moon about the bridge being repaired, [Ari]!

english: I've been saving my allowance for this!
french: J'ai économisé mon argent de poche en attendant ça.
russian: Я всё это время копила карманные деньги!
bulgarian: I've been saving my allowance for this!

english: Now that the bridge is repaired, the Saturday Market is back on!
french: Maintenant que le pont est réparé, le marché du samedi va pouvoir reprendre.
russian: Мост починили, и теперь к нам вернулся Субботний базар!
bulgarian: Now that the bridge is repaired, the Saturday Market is back on!

english: I should probably warn you that my sister has moved up the timetables of several of her other initiatives as a result...
french: Bon, je dois te prévenir que suite à ça, ma sœur a devancé la mise en œuvre de plusieurs autres projets...
russian: Вероятно, стоит тебя предупредить, что теперь моя сестра подвинула график нескольких других амбициозных проектов...
bulgarian: I should probably warn you that my sister has moved up the timetables of several of her other initiatives as a result...

english: Still, it's all to help Mistria grow. Exciting times are ahead!
french: Tout cela, c'est pour que Mistria se développe. Un bel avenir nous attend !
russian: В любом случае, всё это делается ради Мистрии. У нас впереди большое будущее!
bulgarian: Still, it's all to help Mistria grow. Exciting times are ahead!

english: [Ari], thank you so much for your help repairing the bridge!
french: [Ari], merci de l'aide que tu as apportée pour réparer le pont !
russian: [Ari], спасибо тебе большое за помощь с ремонтом моста!
bulgarian: [Ari], thank you so much for your help repairing the bridge!

english: You wouldn't believe how excited Henrietta was when I told her!
french: Henrietta a eu du mal à contenir sa joie, quand je lui ai dit !
russian: Ты не представляешь, как Генриетта обрадовалась, когда я ей рассказал!
bulgarian: You wouldn't believe how excited Henrietta was when I told her!

english: The bridge is repaired, woohoo!
french: Le pont est réparé, youhou !
russian: Мост починили, урааа!
bulgarian: The bridge is repaired, woohoo!

english: Feel free to use the Bathhouse to clean up.
french: D'ailleurs, passe donc aux bains si tu as besoin de te décrasser.
russian: Если хочешь, заходи отмыться в купальню.
bulgarian: Feel free to use the Bathhouse to clean up.

english: If it isn't the talk of the town. I suppose I have to hand it to you, you're willing to get your hands dirty.
french: C'est donc de toi que tout le monde parle. Je dois reconnaître que tu n'hésites pas à mettre la main à la pâte.
russian: Весь город о тебе говорит. Что ж, должна признать, ты не чураешься грязной работы.
bulgarian: If it isn't the talk of the town. I suppose I have to hand it to you, you're willing to get your hands dirty.

english: And I already congratulated Ryis, he did a great job.
french: Oui, j'ai déjà félicité Ryis, il a fait de l'excellent travail.
russian: Я уже поздравил Риза, он отлично справился.
bulgarian: And I already congratulated Ryis, he did a great job.

english: What, you want a pat on the head for doing the bare minimum? Nah.
french: Quoi ? Tu veux des remerciements alors que tu as fait le strict minimum ? Oublie.
russian: Хочешь, чтобы я тебя похвалил за минимальные усилия? Нет уж.
bulgarian: What, you want a pat on the head for doing the bare minimum? Nah.

english: Oh!
french: Oh !
russian: А!
bulgarian: Oh!

english: Well... you're welcome.
french: Ah, euh... Merci.
russian: Что ж... обращайтесь.
bulgarian: Well... you're welcome.

english: What?
french: Quoi ?
russian: Что?
bulgarian: What?

english: The bridge is repaired!
french: Le pont est réparé.
russian: Ремонт моста закончен!
bulgarian: The bridge is repaired!

english: Couldn't have repaired the bridge without your support!
french: On n'aurait pas pu réparer le pont sans ton aide !
russian: Без твоей помощи мы бы не справились с ремонтом моста!
bulgarian: Couldn't have repaired the bridge without your support!

english: Adeline told me all about how you helped out with the bridge. The whole inn thanks you, [Ari]!
french: Adeline m'a dit que tu avais beaucoup contribué à la réparation du pont. Toute l'auberge te remercie, [Ari] !
russian:
Аделина мне столько рассказывала, как ты

помогали

помогалапомогалпомогало ремонтировать мост. В трактире только о тебе и говорят, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Adeline told me all about how you helped out with the bridge. The whole inn thanks you, [Ari]!

english: Well look who it is!
french: Regardez qui voilà !
russian: Смотрите, кто к нам пришёл!
bulgarian: Well look who it is!

english: Be sure to stop by the Saturday Market and enjoy it with the rest of us!
french: Viens au marché du samedi. Tout le monde y sera !
russian: Обязательно зайди на Субботний базар вместе с нами!
bulgarian: Be sure to stop by the Saturday Market and enjoy it with the rest of us!

english: Thank you for your help repairing the bridge, [Ari].
french: Merci d'avoir participé à la réparation du pont, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо за помощь с ремонтом моста, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you for your help repairing the bridge, [Ari].

english: That's great news!
french: C'est une excellente nouvelle !
russian: Какая отличная новость!
bulgarian: That's great news!

english: Oh, that's nice-
french: Oh, c'est bien...
russian: А, это хорошо...
bulgarian: Oh, that's nice-

english: Wait, what?!
french: Qu'est-ce que tu as dit ?!
russian: Погоди, что?!
bulgarian: Wait, what?!

english: That's wonderful news!
french: C'est une excellente nouvelle !
russian: Это же чудесная новость!
bulgarian: That's wonderful news!

english: Come on, let's go tell everyone!
french: Allons prévenir tout le monde !
russian: Пойдём расскажем остальным!
bulgarian: Come on, let's go tell everyone!

english: Hey there, [Ari]! What's up?
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Qu'y a-t-il ?
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Как твои дела?
bulgarian: Hey there, [Ari]! What's up?

english: I've gathered what we need to repair the bridge!
french: J'ai récolté tout ce qu'il nous faut pour réparer le pont !
russian:
Я

собрали

собраласобралсобрало всё, что нужно для ремонта моста!
bulgarian: I've gathered what we need to repair the bridge!

english: Nothing much, just completed the bridge repair donation.
french: Rien de spécial, j'ai fini de récolter les matériaux pour le pont.
russian:
Да ничего, просто

закончили

закончилазакончилзакончило сбор материалов для моста.
bulgarian: Nothing much, just completed the bridge repair donation.

english: So what's this all about, Adeline? Your letter was pretty vague.
french: De quoi s'agit-il, Adeline ? Tu es restée assez vague dans ta lettre.
russian: Так в чём же дело, Аделина? В твоём письме не было подробностей.
bulgarian: So what's this all about, Adeline? Your letter was pretty vague.

english: Exactly! Everyone who lives in Mistria would see some benefit.
french: Exactement ! Cela améliorerait la vie de tous les habitants de Mistria, d'une manière ou d'une autre.
russian: Вот именно! Это будет выгодно всем обитателям Мистрии.
bulgarian: Exactly! Everyone who lives in Mistria would see some benefit.

english: That is, if you two are up to the challenges of running a larger store...
french: Évidemment, il faut que vous vous sentiez capables de gérer un magasin plus grand, tous les deux...
russian: Разумеется, только если вы готовы справляться с управлением большим магазином...
bulgarian: That is, if you two are up to the challenges of running a larger store...

english: Absolutely!
french: Aucun problème !
russian: Непременно!
bulgarian: Absolutely!

english: I thought that might be the case.
french: Je me doutais que ce serait le cas.
russian: Я так и подумала.
bulgarian: I thought that might be the case.

english: Unfortunately, since this isn't a recovery project, I'm afraid the Capital won't be able to assist.
french: Malheureusement, comme il ne s'agit pas d'un projet de reconstruction, la capitale ne nous aidera pas.
russian: К сожалению, поскольку это не восстановительный проект, мы не можем полагаться на помощь из столицы.
bulgarian: Unfortunately, since this isn't a recovery project, I'm afraid the Capital won't be able to assist.

english: If we all pitch in, it'll be no problem!
french: Si nous participons tous, on y arrivera !
russian: Всё получится, если мы все вложим средства!
