english: An upgraded, state of the art kitchen and bar! We'll be able to offer even more dishes!
french: Une cuisine et un bar dernier cri ! On pourra proposer des tas de nouveaux plats.
russian: Улучшенная кухня, оборудованная по последнему слову техники! Мы сможем готовить ещё больше разных блюд!
bulgarian: An upgraded, state of the art kitchen and bar! We'll be able to offer even more dishes!

english: Well, now! And what's this about furniture and decor?
french: Voyez-vous ça ! Et pour ce qui est du mobilier et de la décoration ?
russian: Ну и ну! А что тут написано про мебель и оформление?
bulgarian: Well, now! And what's this about furniture and decor?

english: Ryis and Landen have already agreed to help us do some redecorating.
french: Ryis et Landen ont déjà accepté de nous aider pour la décoration.
russian: Риз и Ланден уже согласились помочь нам с деталями интерьера.
bulgarian: Ryis and Landen have already agreed to help us do some redecorating.

english: At least let me make us some drinks!
french: Laissez-moi au moins vous offrir un verre !
russian: Давай хотя бы напитками угостим!
bulgarian: At least let me make us some drinks!

english: I'll have something fruity!
french: Quelque chose de fruité pour moi.
russian: Я хочу что-нибудь фруктовое!
bulgarian: I'll have something fruity!

english: Bitter and full-bodied, please!
french: Quelque chose d'amer mais qui a du corps !
russian: Что-нибудь полнотелое и горькое, пожалуйста!
bulgarian: Bitter and full-bodied, please!

english: Can I get a glass of water?
french: Je peux avoir un verre d'eau ?
russian: Можно мне стакан воды?
bulgarian: Can I get a glass of water?

english: We'll even stock some of the new decor for sale! They'll be perfect souvenirs for our visitors, don't you think?
french: Et nous proposerons même ce nouveau style à la vente ! Ça fera de jolis souvenirs pour les visiteurs, vous ne trouvez pas ?
russian: Мы закажем побольше, чтобы можно было их продавать! Будет отличный сувенир для гостей.
bulgarian: We'll even stock some of the new decor for sale! They'll be perfect souvenirs for our visitors, don't you think?

english: Runners for the tables, new cushions for the chairs, you've really thought of everything, Reina.
french: De jolis tissus pour couvrir les tables, de nouveaux coussins pour les chaises... Tu as pensé à tout, Reina.
russian: Дорожки для столов и подушки для стульев — всё у тебя продумано до мелочей, Рейна!
bulgarian: Runners for the tables, new cushions for the chairs, you've really thought of everything, Reina.

english: And this soup cauldron proposal-
french: Et cette nouvelle marmite pour la soupe...
russian: А что касается супового котла...
bulgarian: And this soup cauldron proposal-

english: That's right, bigger servings for everyone, loaded with delicious ingredients!
french: Oui, tout le monde aura droit à des rations plus généreuses et on mettra plein de délicieux ingrédients !
russian: Увеличим, буду большие порции для всех и вкусные ингредиенты!
bulgarian: That's right, bigger servings for everyone, loaded with delicious ingredients!

english: This looks fantastic, Reina!
french: Tout ça est fantastique, Reina !
russian: Рейна, это просто невероятный план!
bulgarian: This looks fantastic, Reina!

english: When do we start?
french: Quand est-ce qu'on s'y met ?
russian: Когда начинаем?
bulgarian: When do we start?

english: Jo, Hemlock, what do you two think?
french: Jo, Hemlock, qu'en dites-vous ?
russian: Джо, Хемлок, а вы что думаете?
bulgarian: Jo, Hemlock, what do you two think?

english: As soon as my parents approve!
french: Dès que mes parents nous donnent le feu vert !
russian: Как только родители согласятся!
bulgarian: As soon as my parents approve!

english: I'm a bit overwhelmed, to tell you the truth!
french: Cela fait beaucoup d'un coup, pour être très honnête !
russian: Честно говоря, это всё так внезапно...
bulgarian: I'm a bit overwhelmed, to tell you the truth!

english: With a proposal this well thought out, how could we say no?
french: Avec des propositions aussi abouties, comment refuser ?
russian: Такое детально распланированное предложение — разве мы можем отказаться?
bulgarian: With a proposal this well thought out, how could we say no?

english: I'm so proud of you, Reina.
french: Je suis très fière de toi, Reina.
russian: Я тобой горжусь, Рейна.
bulgarian: I'm so proud of you, Reina.

english: Aw, you two...
french: Oh, arrêtez, tous les deux...
russian: Ой, перестаньте...
bulgarian: Aw, you two...

english: You got it!
french: Entendu !
russian: Сейчас!
bulgarian: You got it!

english: I'll get the $Donation Box$ set up outside. We're all counting on you, [Ari].
french: Je vais installer la $boîte de dons$ dehors. Nous comptons tous sur toi, [Ari].
russian: Я поставлю у входа $ящик для пожертвований$. Мы рассчитываем на тебя, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'll get the $Donation Box$ set up outside. We're all counting on you, [Ari].

english: Ooh, me too!
french: Oooh, pour moi aussi !
russian: О, мне тоже налей!
bulgarian: Ooh, me too!

english: I've got a bottle here from the winter of the Two Week Blizzard, let's crack it open!
french: J'ai là une bouteille qui remonte à l'hiver du Blizzard de deux semaines. Débouchons-la pour l'occasion !
russian: У меня тут осталась бутылочка с зимы Двухнедельной метели. Давайте откроем!
bulgarian: I've got a bottle here from the winter of the Two Week Blizzard, let's crack it open!

english: I suppose I'll have what [Ari] is having then.
french: Je prends comme [Ari].
russian: Тогда я возьму то же, что и [Ari].
bulgarian: I suppose I'll have what [Ari] is having then.

english: So what can we help you two with?
french: Alors, qu'est-ce qu'on peut faire pour vous ?
russian: Так как мы можем вам помочь?
bulgarian: So what can we help you two with?

english: As you know, we recently rebuilt Hayden's barn and coop, giving him the room to raise new animals and securing a new source of exports for the town.
french: Comme vous le savez, nous avons rénové la grange et le poulailler d'Hayden pour qu'il accueille plus d'animaux et qu'on puisse exporter de nouveaux produits.
russian: Как вы знаете, мы недавно обновили хлев и вольер Хейдена. Теперь у него воявилось место для новых животных, а у города — новые экспортные товары.
bulgarian: As you know, we recently rebuilt Hayden's barn and coop, giving him the room to raise new animals and securing a new source of exports for the town.

english: And here's [Ari]!
french: Voilà [Ari] !
russian: А вот и [Ari]!
bulgarian: And here's [Ari]!

english: Thank goodness for Reina!
french: Heureusement que Reina est intervenue !
russian: Повезло, что Рейна нас выручила!
bulgarian: Thank goodness for Reina!

english: I never expected Jo and Hemlock to decline, they caught me completely off guard.
french: Je n'imaginais pas que Jo et Hemlock refuseraient. Ça m'a vraiment déstabilisée.
russian: Я не ожидала, что Джо и Хемлок захотят отказаться, это было так внезапно.
bulgarian: I never expected Jo and Hemlock to decline, they caught me completely off guard.

english: Lots to do around here before we can start construction, but don't you worry [Ari], we'll be ready as soon as you've collected all the materials!
french: Nous avons du pain sur la planche avant de lancer les travaux, mais ne t'en fais pas, [Ari]. Quand tu auras réuni tous les matériaux, nous serons prêts !
russian: Перед началом строительства ещё много всего надо сделать. Но не волнуйся, [Ari]: когда соберёшь материалы, мы будем готовы!
bulgarian: Lots to do around here before we can start construction, but don't you worry [Ari], we'll be ready as soon as you've collected all the materials!

english: That daughter of mine! She's grown up into a fine business woman.
french: Ma fille ne cesse de m'impressionner ! Elle est devenue une vraie entrepreneuse.
russian: Вот это у меня дочь! Выросла в такую деловую женщину.
bulgarian: That daughter of mine! She's grown up into a fine business woman.

english: And I suggested the special menu for our bug customers!
french: Et c'est moi qui ai suggéré le menu spécial pour nos clients insectes.
russian: А я предложил особое меню для посетителей-жуков.
bulgarian: And I suggested the special menu for our bug customers!

english: She told me there wasn't any room for the arena royale though.
french: Par contre, elle m'a dit qu'il n'y aurait pas assez de place pour l'arène royale.
russian: А мне она сказала, что на гладиаторскую арену не хватит места.
bulgarian: She told me there wasn't any room for the arena royale though.

english: Wait... did my sister use ANY of our ideas?
french: Attendez... Est-ce que notre sœur a gardé une seule de nos idées ?
russian: Стоп... Сестра не использовала НИ ОДНУ из наших идей?
bulgarian: Wait... did my sister use ANY of our ideas?

english: Did Reina show you the plans for the Inn? We helped, you know! I proposed the six room Princess Suite!
french: Reina t'a montré les plans de rénovation de l'auberge ? On l'a aidée, tu sais ! J'ai eu l'idée de la suite princière avec ses six pièces.
russian: Рейна тебе показывала планы трактира? Между прочим, мы ей помогали! Я предложила построить покои принцессы из шести комнат.
bulgarian: Did Reina show you the plans for the Inn? We helped, you know! I proposed the six room Princess Suite!

english: That Reina had quite the proposal for the Inn, didn't she? Branded furniture, now why didn't I think of that?
french: Les propositions de Reina pour l'auberge sont impressionnantes. Comment n'ai-je pas pensé à du mobilier de marque ?
russian: У Рейны такие серьёзные планы на трактир! Фирменная мебель — как же я сам не догадался?
bulgarian: That Reina had quite the proposal for the Inn, didn't she? Branded furniture, now why didn't I think of that?

english: We'll really be leaving our mark on Mistria for generations to come.
french: On aura laissé notre marque sur Mistria pour les siècles à venir.
russian: Наш след останется в истории Мистрии для будущих поколений.
bulgarian: We'll really be leaving our mark on Mistria for generations to come.

english: Pretty cool to think that when we're done with the Inn, we'll have worked on every building on that street, huh?
french: J'aime bien cette idée qu'une fois l'auberge terminée, on aura rénové tous les bâtiments de cette rue. Sympa, non ?
russian: Занимательная мысль: трактир — последнее здание на этой улице, с которым мы ещё не работали.
bulgarian: Pretty cool to think that when we're done with the Inn, we'll have worked on every building on that street, huh?

english: I'm ready!
french: Je suis prête !
russian: Я готова!
bulgarian: I'm ready!

english: Your mission is to help me decorate the dining room! The whole town is depending on you!
french: Votre mission consiste à m'aider à décorer la salle à manger. La ville compte sur vous !
russian: Ваша задача — помочь мне оформить обеденный зал! Весь город на вас рассчитывает!
bulgarian: Your mission is to help me decorate the dining room! The whole town is depending on you!

english: Oh, and Balor, Olric, come with us.
french: Oh, Balor et Olric, suivez-nous.
russian: А, Балор, Ольрик, вы тоже нужны.
bulgarian: Oh, and Balor, Olric, come with us.

english: You can do the heavy lifting!
french: On a des trucs lourds à déplacer !
russian: Будете помогать с тяжёлыми вещами!
bulgarian: You can do the heavy lifting!

english: Helping out the Dragonguard? Wow!
french: On va aider la Garde des dragons ? Waouh !
russian: Помогать Драконьей страже? Ничего себе!
bulgarian: Helping out the Dragonguard? Wow!

english: It's all coming together so fast, I think they're almost done.
french: Tout va si vite. Je crois qu'ils ont presque terminé.
russian: Как быстро всё строится! По-моему, они почти закончили.
bulgarian: It's all coming together so fast, I think they're almost done.

english: Would you look at that!
french: Regarde-moi ça !
russian: Какая красота!
bulgarian: Would you look at that!

english: Shall we go inside?
french: Que diriez-vous d'entrer ?
russian: Приглашаю вас внутрь!
bulgarian: Shall we go inside?

english: Welcome to the new and improved Sleeping Dragon Inn, everyone!
french: Bienvenue à la toute nouvelle auberge du Dragon qui dort !
russian: Приветствуем вас в обновлённом трактире «Спящий дракон»!
bulgarian: Welcome to the new and improved Sleeping Dragon Inn, everyone!

english: It's a dream come true!
french: J'ai l'impression de rêver !
russian: Это просто мечта!
bulgarian: It's a dream come true!

english: Only too happy to contribute, seeing as we'll all be benefiting.
french: Nous sommes ravis de participer, puisque nous en profiterons tous.
russian: Мы рады вас поддержать, ведь обновление пойдёт на пользу всем.
bulgarian: Only too happy to contribute, seeing as we'll all be benefiting.

english: Say, the bar is already stocked!
french: Mais le bar est déjà approvisionné !
russian: Ничего себе, бар уже битком набит!
bulgarian: Say, the bar is already stocked!

english: No thanks are necessary, but I wouldn't say no to a drink!
french: Inutile de nous remercier, mais je ne refuserais pas un verre !
russian: Можете не благодарить, хотя выпить я бы сейчас не отказался!
bulgarian: No thanks are necessary, but I wouldn't say no to a drink!

english: I'd say drinks are on the house for all of you!
french: Écoutez tous ! C'est la maison qui régale !
russian: Сегодня вам всем напитки за счёт заведения!
bulgarian: I'd say drinks are on the house for all of you!

english: And I'll get cooking! I can't wait to break in my new kitchen!
french: Moi, je vais préparer à manger ! J'ai hâte d'étrenner ma toute nouvelle cuisine !
russian: Пойду займусь готовкой! Мне уже так хочется опробовать новую кухню!
bulgarian: And I'll get cooking! I can't wait to break in my new kitchen!

english: Thank you everyone, I can't tell you how much I'm looking forward to welcoming you all here for many more seasons to come!
french: Merci à tous. Vous n'imaginez pas à quel point je serai heureuse de vous accueillir ici pour encore bien des saisons.
russian: Трудно передать, как я вам всем благодарна. Надеюсь видеть вас у нас в гостях ещё много-много лет!
bulgarian: Thank you everyone, I can't tell you how much I'm looking forward to welcoming you all here for many more seasons to come!

english: You two ready?
french: Vous êtes prêts, vous deux ?
russian: Вы готовы?
bulgarian: You two ready?

english: Always!
french: À ton avis ?!
russian: Всегда готовы!
bulgarian: Always!

english: Come on Hayden, let's get these planter boxes ready!
french: Viens, Hayden. Allons installer ces nouvelles jardinières !
russian: Пойдём, Хейден, пора расставлять клумбы!
bulgarian: Come on Hayden, let's get these planter boxes ready!

english: I've got the finest Sweetwater Farm soil ready for 'em!
french: J'ai apporté la meilleure terre de la ferme de Doucerive pour les remplir !
russian: Я собрал лучший грунт с фермы «Сладководье»!
bulgarian: I've got the finest Sweetwater Farm soil ready for 'em!

english: Dragonguard, assemble!
french: Garde des dragons, formez les rangs !
russian: Драконья стража, общий сбор!
bulgarian: Dragonguard, assemble!

english: Oh boy, oh boy!
french: Bon sang, bon sang !
russian: Сейчас-сейчас!
bulgarian: Oh boy, oh boy!

english: Time to show everyone what we've got!
french: Il est temps de montrer à tout le monde de quoi on est capables !
russian: Покажем им, на что мы способны!
bulgarian: Time to show everyone what we've got!

english: My word! It looks like most of the town came out!
french: Oh là là ! Presque toute la ville est présente !
russian: Боже мой! Кажется, тут чуть ли не весь город собрался!
bulgarian: My word! It looks like most of the town came out!

english: I'm glad they left my room alone in the construction, some of the merchandise I keep in there is quite delicate.
french: Heureusement que personne n'a touché à ma chambre, pendant les travaux. Les marchandises que j'y stocke sont fragiles.
russian: Я доволен, что мою комнату не трогали во время реставрации. Я там храню некоторые весьма хрупкие товары.
bulgarian: I'm glad they left my room alone in the construction, some of the merchandise I keep in there is quite delicate.

english: We're not raising the prices though.
french: Mais nous n'augmenterons pas les prix pour autant.
russian: Но цены мы повышать не будем.
bulgarian: We're not raising the prices though.

english: Business is right up with the Inn's refurbishment!
french: Les affaires sont florissantes depuis la rénovation de l'auberge.
russian: После обновления трактира дела пошли в гору!
bulgarian: Business is right up with the Inn's refurbishment!

english: The Inn has been in the family for generations, it's so wonderful to see what it's grown into!
french: Cette auberge est dans notre famille depuis plusieurs générations. C'est merveilleux de voir ce qu'elle est devenue !
russian: Наша семья содержит этот трактир уже много поколений. Чудесно видеть, как он преобразился!
bulgarian: The Inn has been in the family for generations, it's so wonderful to see what it's grown into!

english: But the Inn looks so nice now, it's hard to imagine there's a better place to go in all of Aldaria!
french: Mais la nouvelle auberge est si belle que je ne suis pas sûre de trouver un meilleur endroit dans tout Aldaria !
russian: Но трактир теперь так чудно выглядит. Вряд ли во всей Альдарии найдётся более уютное место!
bulgarian: But the Inn looks so nice now, it's hard to imagine there's a better place to go in all of Aldaria!

english: You know, when I grow up I was planning to go to the Capital to seek my fortune...
french: Tu sais, j'avais l'intention de tenter ma chance à la capitale, quand je serai grande...
russian: Знаешь, я собиралась поехать искать счастья в столице, когда вырасту...
bulgarian: You know, when I grow up I was planning to go to the Capital to seek my fortune...

english: I really can't thank you enough, [Ari]. The new kitchen is a dream to work in!
french: Je ne sais pas comment te remercier, [Ari]. Cette nouvelle cuisine est une merveille !
russian: Я тебе безмерно благодарна, [Ari]. Работать на новой кухне — одно удовольствие!
bulgarian: I really can't thank you enough, [Ari]. The new kitchen is a dream to work in!

english: Are we ready to get started on the Inn? The whole town has been looking forward to this!
french: Les travaux de l'auberge peuvent commencer ? Tous les habitants ont hâte de voir le résultat !
russian: Мы готовы начинать расширение трактира? Горожане уже заждались!
bulgarian: Are we ready to get started on the Inn? The whole town has been looking forward to this!

english: So, if we combine what we have in the town's coffers with the grant I've secured from the Capital, we've made huge progress toward repairing the $Mill$!
french: Donc, en additionnant les réserves de la ville et le prêt que j'ai obtenu de la capitale, on n'est plus très loin de pouvoir retaper le $moulin$.
russian: Так вот, если взять всю нашу казну и добавить грант, который я получила из столицы, то будет почти достаточно для восстановления $мельницы$!
bulgarian: So, if we combine what we have in the town's coffers with the grant I've secured from the Capital, we've made huge progress toward repairing the $Mill$!

english: I'll set up a $Donation Box$ at the door of the Mill. You can deposit the materials there and then bring the funds to me when you're ready.
french: J'installe une $boîte de dons$ devant la porte du moulin. Tu pourras y déposer les matériaux et m'apporter les fonds quand tout sera prêt.
russian:

french: C'est beaucoup demander, alors prends ton temps.
russian: Это серьёзная задача, так что не спеши!
bulgarian: It's a big job so take your time!

english: Good to have your help on this.
french: C'est bien que tu sois là pour nous aider.
russian: Спасибо, что помогаешь нам.
bulgarian: Good to have your help on this.

english: Yahoo! You can do it, [Ari]!
french: Youhou ! Tu vas y arriver, [Ari] !
russian: Ура! Ты справишься, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Yahoo! You can do it, [Ari]!

english: Fantastic!
french: Génial !
russian: Потрясающе!
bulgarian: Fantastic!

english: But we're still $1000t$ short...
french: Il nous manque encore $1 000 tesserae$...
russian: Но нам всё ещё не хватает $1000 тессер$...
bulgarian: But we're still $1000t$ short...

english: Ah...
french: Ah...
russian: Эх...
bulgarian: Ah...

french: Sans compter les matériaux de construction. Il nous faut encore au moins $150 rondins de bois$, $200 pierres$ et $2 lingots de cuivre$ pour les réparations.
russian: И строительные материалы тоже нужны. На завершение ремонта понадобится ещё $150 древесины$, $200 камня$ и $2 слитка меди$.
bulgarian: We need more building materials too. At least another $150 Wood$,\n$200 Stone$, and $2 Copper Ingots$ to complete the repairs.

english: Don't worry, I can help!
french: Aucun souci, je vais participer !
russian: Не переживайте, я помогу!
bulgarian: Don't worry, I can help!

english: Feels like everyone is waiting for me to volunteer...
french: J'ai l'impression que vous attendez tous que je me porte volontaire...
russian: Все уже ждут, что я вызовусь помогать...
bulgarian: Feels like everyone is waiting for me to volunteer...

english: What a splendid idea!
french: Quelle super idée !
russian: Замечательная идея!
bulgarian: What a splendid idea!

english: [Ari], you're the best!
french: [Ari], tu es génial<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> !
russian: [Ari], ты лучше всех.
bulgarian: [Ari], you're the best!

english: You can count on me to get the job done fast when you've gathered the materials!
french: Une fois les matériaux réunis, je me mettrai en priorité sur les réparations.
russian: Я всё быстро построю, как только соберёшь материалы. Можешь на меня положиться!
bulgarian: You can count on me to get the job done fast when you've gathered the materials!

english: And I'll teach you all there is to know about raising animals and milling their feed when it's ready!
french: Et je t'apprendrai tout sur les animaux d'élevage et la préparation de leur nourriture !
russian: А я тогда расскажу тебе, как ухаживать за животными и изготавливать молотый корм!
bulgarian: And I'll teach you all there is to know about raising animals and milling their feed when it's ready!

english: [Ari]! Great timing, we were just about to get started.
french: [Ari], tu arrives à point nommé ! Nous étions sur le point de commencer.
russian: [Ari]! Ты вовремя, мы как раз только собрались.
bulgarian: [Ari]! Great timing, we were just about to get started.

english: Whew!
french: Pfiou !
russian: Фух!
bulgarian: Whew!

english: Wonderful work everyone! Mistria finally has its mill back! You'll be able to make all kinds of $new products$ now, [Ari].
french: Vous avez tous fait un travail remarquable ! Mistria a retrouvé son moulin ! Désormais, tu pourras fabriquer plein de $nouveaux produits$, [Ari].
russian: Чудесная работа, ребята! Наконец-то в Мистрии снова есть мельница! [Ari], теперь ты можешь делать много $новых продуктов$.
bulgarian: Wonderful work everyone! Mistria finally has its mill back! You'll be able to make all kinds of $new products$ now, [Ari].

english: Would you like to hear more about how to $process items$?
french: Tu veux savoir comment $fabriquer des objets$.
russian: Хочешь, я расскажу тебе, как $пользоваться мельницей$?
bulgarian: Would you like to hear more about how to $process items$?

english: Yes, please!
french: Oui, s'il te plaît.
russian: Расскажи, пожалуйста!
bulgarian: Yes, please!

english: I think I'm good.
french: Je vais me débrouiller.
russian: Спасибо, я справлюсь.
bulgarian: I think I'm good.

english: Ohh, I suppose you've done this before, huh?
french: Oh, j'imagine que ce n'est pas ta première fois, hein ?
russian:
О, так значит, ты уже

знакомы

знакомазнакомзнакомо с процессом.
bulgarian: Ohh, I suppose you've done this before, huh?

english: I won't have to import overpriced grain anymore! Henrietta and the rest of my animals are going to be thrilled.
french: Je n'aurai plus à faire venir du grain hors de prix, maintenant ! Henrietta et mes autres animaux seront très contents.
russian: Мне больше не придётся заказывать дорогущее импортное зерно! Генриетта и остальные животные порадуются.
bulgarian: I won't have to import overpriced grain anymore! Henrietta and the rest of my animals are going to be thrilled.

english: If you want to try your own hand at $raising animals$, [Ari], you'll need somewhere for them to live.
french: [Ari], si tu veux $élever des animaux$, il leur faudra un endroit où vivre.
russian: Если хочешь тоже попробовать $выращивать животных$, [Ari], тебе нужно место, куда их поселить.
bulgarian: If you want to try your own hand at $raising animals$, [Ari], you'll need somewhere for them to live.

english: Just come by the workshop! With the right materials, we can set you up with $Coops$ and $Barns$.
french: Passe à l'atelier ! Si tu as les matériaux adéquats, on te construira des $granges$ et des $poulaillers$.
russian: Приходи ко мне в мастерскую! Если будут материалы, ты сможешь строить $вольеры$ и $хлева$.
bulgarian: Just come by the workshop! With the right materials, we can set you up with $Coops$ and $Barns$.

english: Thank you again everyone!
french: Encore merci à tout le monde !
russian: Спасибо всем ещё раз!
bulgarian: Thank you again everyone!

english: Incredible!
french: Incroyable !
russian: Невероятно!
bulgarian: Incredible!

english: You're indispensable, [Ari]! Let's get this mill running again!
french: On n'y arrivera pas sans toi, [Ari] ! Le moulin doit reprendre du service.
russian: Это неоценимый труд, [Ari]! Пойдём заведём нашу мельницу снова!
bulgarian: You're indispensable, [Ari]! Let's get this mill running again!

english: I wouldn't call it a party, but it is needful work.
french: Bon, ce n'est peut-être pas une fête, mais c'est un travail très utile.
russian: Я бы не сказал, что это очень весело, но работа необходимая.
bulgarian: I wouldn't call it a party, but it is needful work.

english: I've needed to watch my step around here, especially at night.
french: Je dois toujours faire attention où je mets les pieds, par ici, surtout la nuit.
russian: В этом месте надо смотреть под ноги, особенно ночью.
bulgarian: I've needed to watch my step around here, especially at night.

english: With the foot traffic the square gets, we're lucky no one twisted an ankle or worse.
french: Vu le passage sur la place, nous avons de la chance que personne ne se soit foulé une cheville, ou pire.
russian: Учитывая, сколько людей бывает на этой площади, нам повезло, что никто не подвернул ногу.
bulgarian: With the foot traffic the square gets, we're lucky no one twisted an ankle or worse.

english: Hey, you three!
french: Salut, vous trois !
russian: Привет, ребята!
bulgarian: Hey, you three!

english: Doing some repairs? Looks fun!
french: Vous remettez un peu les choses en état ? Ça a l'air amusant !
russian: Решили починить площадь? Выглядит интересно!
bulgarian: Doing some repairs? Looks fun!

english: Why don't you two join us?
french: Vous ne voulez pas nous aider, toutes les deux ?
russian: Хотите с нами?
bulgarian: Why don't you two join us?

english: I'm having a blast!
french: Je m'éclate !
russian: Да мы просто развлекаемся!
bulgarian: I'm having a blast!

english: Why not?
french: Pourquoi pas ?
russian: Почему бы и нет?
bulgarian: Why not?

english: Oooh, count me in!
french: Oh, bien sûr !
russian: Ооо, я тоже хочу!
bulgarian: Oooh, count me in!

english: Definitely better to take care of these cracks now!
french: Il vaut mieux reboucher tout de suite ces fissures.
russian: Эти трещины лучше заделать как можно скорее!
bulgarian: Definitely better to take care of these cracks now!

english: Knowing my sister, Dell would probably try to dig these even deeper...
french: Connaissant ma sœur, elle serait capable de continuer à creuser...
russian: Я знаю свою сестру: Делл наверняка захочет раскопать их ещё глубже...
bulgarian: Knowing my sister, Dell would probably try to dig these even deeper...

english: We're making such good progress. Thanks for helping out you two!
french: Nous avançons bien. Merci à toutes les deux de nous aider !
russian: Мы уже так много сделали. Спасибо вам большое!
bulgarian: We're making such good progress. Thanks for helping out you two!

english: Well, maybe it's both!
french: Disons que ça peut être les deux à la fois !
russian: По-моему, и то и другое!
bulgarian: Well, maybe it's both!

english: It hardly feels like work when we all get to chat!
french: Quand on papote, le travail avance tout seul.
russian: Мы так хорошо болтаем, что это почти и не работа!
bulgarian: It hardly feels like work when we all get to chat!

english: This is going to leave us with a lot of leftover stone...
french: Il va nous rester pas mal de pierres inutilisées...
russian: У нас останется много ненужного камня...
bulgarian: This is going to leave us with a lot of leftover stone...

english: I think we have a use for it. Why don't we fix the steps up to the Summit?
french: Je crois qu'on va leur trouver une utilité. Pourquoi ne pas réparer les marches qui mènent au sommet avec ?
russian: Думаю, нам есть, куда его применить. Может, починим ступени на Вершину?
bulgarian: I think we have a use for it. Why don't we fix the steps up to the Summit?

english: Ooh, these would make perfect repair materials! And there's less hauling for us to do as well.
french: Oooh, ce serait un matériau parfait pour les réparations ! Et nous n'aurons pas beaucoup de transport à faire.
russian: Точно, это как раз подходящий материал! И таскать придётся не так далеко.
bulgarian: Ooh, these would make perfect repair materials! And there's less hauling for us to do as well.

english: My word, was tidying the Museum campus on the docket for today?
french: Ça alors, je ne savais pas que le nettoyage des abords du musée était prévu aujourd'hui.
russian: Ничего себе, у вас сегодня на повестке уборка музейного двора?
bulgarian: My word, was tidying the Museum campus on the docket for today?

english: I think these youngsters are trying to get one up on us, Errol! Let's show them what we can do!
french: Je crois que ces gamins essaient de nous couper l'herbe sous le pied, Errol ! On va leur montrer de quoi on est capables !
russian: Смотри-ка, Эррол, молодёжь перед нами выделывается! Сейчас мы им покажем!
bulgarian: I think these youngsters are trying to get one up on us, Errol! Let's show them what we can do!

english: Apologies, I can see my exuberance has gotten the better of me.
french: Mes excuses, je crois que mon enthousiasme a pris le dessus.
russian: Ох, простите мой чрезмерный энтузиазм.
bulgarian: Apologies, I can see my exuberance has gotten the better of me.

english: You old show off!
french: Espèce de vieux frimeur !
russian: Вот же старый хвастун!
bulgarian: You old show off!

english: Isn't it wonderful to restore old stonework? Untold generations of Mistrians have made use of these steps!
french: Ce n'est pas fantastique de restaurer ces anciennes volées de marches, non ? Imagine toutes ces générations de Mistriens qui les ont gravies !
russian: Восстанавливать старую кладку — чудесное занятие, правда? По этим ступеням ходили многие поколения мистрийцев!
bulgarian: Isn't it wonderful to restore old stonework? Untold generations of Mistrians have made use of these steps!

english: More importantly, we'll finally have access to that lemon tree up on the hill again!
french: Plus important encore, nous pourrons à nouveau arriver au citronnier de la colline !
russian: А самое главное, мы, наконец, сможем добраться до лимонного дерева на том холме!
bulgarian: More importantly, we'll finally have access to that lemon tree up on the hill again!

english: With Mistria back on its feet, I thought it was high time to take care of some of the debris and other damage the earthquake left behind.
french: Maintenant que Mistria sort la tête de l'eau, je me disais qu'il était temps de nous occuper des débris qui jonchent encore la ville et des dégâts encore visibles.
russian: Мистрия встала на ноги, так что я подумала: пора разделаться с обломками и прочим уроном от землетрясения.
bulgarian: With Mistria back on its feet, I thought it was high time to take care of some of the debris and other damage the earthquake left behind.

english: And the summit! The view up there can't be beat.
french: Et monter jusqu'au sommet ! On a une vue imprenable de là-haut.
russian: И до Вершины! Оттуда самый лучший вид.
bulgarian: And the summit! The view up there can't be beat.

english: So that's what all the noise was.
french: Ah, c'est pour ça qu'il y a autant de boucan !
russian: Так вот что это за шум.
bulgarian: So that's what all the noise was.

english: Ryis!
french: Ryis !
russian: Риз!
bulgarian: Ryis!

english: March?
french: March ?
russian: Март?
bulgarian: March?

english: Let's go!
french: Allons-y !
russian: Пойдём!
bulgarian: Let's go!

english: Whew! I'd say that's a job well done.
french: Eh bien, c'est ce que j'appelle du travail bien fait.
russian: Фух! По-моему, отлично поработали.
bulgarian: Whew! I'd say that's a job well done.

english: Shall we head up to the summit? I confess I've missed the view.
french: Et si nous allions jusqu'au sommet ? Je dois avouer que la vue m'a manqué.
russian: Может, поднимемся на Вершину? Признаюсь, я соскучился по этому виду.
bulgarian: Shall we head up to the summit? I confess I've missed the view.

english: Yeah!
french: Oui !
russian: Давайте!
bulgarian: Yeah!

english: I can't believe it! My whole list checked off so quickly!
french: Je n'arrive pas à y croire ! Nous avons déjà terminé tout ce que j'avais sur ma liste !
russian: В моём списке уже выполнены все пункты! Даже не верится!
bulgarian: I can't believe it! My whole list checked off so quickly!

english: I'm sure the whole town would appreciate it being dealt with.
french: Je suis sûre que tous les habitants aimeraient que tout soit remis en état.
russian: Наверняка весь город порадуется, когда мы всё приберём.
bulgarian: I'm sure the whole town would appreciate it being dealt with.

english: Let's get beautifying!
french: Que l'embellissement commence !
russian: Займёмся благоустройством!
bulgarian: Let's get beautifying!

english: Seems like a lot of work for three people...
french: Ça va faire beaucoup pour trois personnes...
russian: С виду здесь работы больше, чем на троих...
bulgarian: Seems like a lot of work for three people...

english: Next time just put out a request, Adeline.
french: La prochaine fois, tu devrais juste mettre une requête, Adeline.
russian: В следующий раз просто повесь прошение, Аделина.
bulgarian: Next time just put out a request, Adeline.

english: Miss Celine is correct. Where Mistria is concerned, I believe there is no one in town who wouldn't pitch in.
french: Mademoiselle Céline a raison. Quand cela concerne Mistria, tous les habitants sont prêts à apporter leur aide.
russian: Мисс Селин права. Когда дело касается Мистрии, по-моему, никто в городе не откажется помочь.
bulgarian: Miss Celine is correct. Where Mistria is concerned, I believe there is no one in town who wouldn't pitch in.

english: Everyone... thank you.
french: Merci... à vous tous.
russian: Ребята... Спасибо вам всем.
bulgarian: Everyone... thank you.

english: Thanks, [Ari]!
french: Merci [Ari] !
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari]!

english: W-well I'm sure we can make a start of things at least!
french: B-Bon, nous pouvons au moins commencer !
russian: Н-ну, мы можем хотя бы начать!
bulgarian: W-well I'm sure we can make a start of things at least!

english: It would go faster with more help, but...
french: C'est vrai que nous irions plus vite avec un peu d'aide, mais...
russian: Мы бы справились быстрее, если бы у нас была помощь, но...
bulgarian: It would go faster with more help, but...

english: Eiland, we talked about this. Everyone is so busy already, we need to shoulder the extra burden!
french: Eiland, nous en avons déjà parlé. Tout le monde a largement de quoi faire, c'est à nous de gérer les tâches supplémentaires.
russian: Эйланд, мы уже это обсуждали. У всех и так есть свои дела, так что эта обязанность ложится на нас!
bulgarian: Eiland, we talked about this. Everyone is so busy already, we need to shoulder the extra burden!

english: The sooner we start the sooner we're done! Let's go!
french: Plus vite nous nous y mettrons, plus vite nous aurons terminé !
russian: Чем раньше начнём, тем раньше закончим! Давайте!
bulgarian: The sooner we start the sooner we're done! Let's go!

english: [Ari], you're here! Now we can get the party started!
french: [Ari], te voilà ! La fête peut enfin commencer !
russian: [Ari], ты здесь! Что ж, пора повеселиться!
bulgarian: [Ari], you're here! Now we can get the party started!

english: We ran short in the days after the earthquake, it'd be a weight off my mind to know we have extra stock.
french: Nous avons connu une pénurie dans les jours qui ont suivi le tremblement de terre et je me sentirais rassurée en sachant que nous avons des réserves.
russian: Весь запас ушёл в дни после землетрясения. Мне бы жилось спокойнее, если бы я знала, что у нас есть ещё.
bulgarian: We ran short in the days after the earthquake, it'd be a weight off my mind to know we have extra stock.

english: I had something a little more substantial in mind...
french: Je pensais à quelque chose d'un peu plus nourrissant...
russian: Я имела в виду что-то более существенное...
bulgarian: I had something a little more substantial in mind...

english: Could you ship $10 Crops$ to help resupply our food rations? I'll give you these seeds to get you started!
french: Pourrais-tu expédier $10 produits cultivés$ pour reconstituer nos réserves de nourriture ? Je te donne ces graines pour que tu puisses t'y mettre !
russian: Могу я попросить тебя отправить $10 плодов$? Это поможет пополнить запасы продовольствия. Я дам тебе семена, чтобы было, с чего начинать!
bulgarian: Could you ship $10 Crops$ to help resupply our food rations? I'll give you these seeds to get you started!

english: Locally grown crops keep well, and they're filling and nutritious too.
french: Les cultures de proximité se conservent bien, et elles sont saines et nourrissantes.
russian: Местные культуры хорошо хранятся. К тому же они питательные и сытные.
bulgarian: Locally grown crops keep well, and they're filling and nutritious too.

english: I think we'll all sleep easier with the emergency stockpile refilled, don't you?
french: Nous dormirons tous mieux quand nous aurons reconstitué nos réserves d'urgences, pas vrai ?
russian: Думаю, когда у нас будут чрезвычайные запасы, мы все сможем спать спокойно.
bulgarian: I think we'll all sleep easier with the emergency stockpile refilled, don't you?

english: That's a great idea! Our first aid supplies should cover all the bases.
french: Très bonne idée ! Nous devons pouvoir répondre à toutes les urgences.
russian: Отличная идея! Нам нужен широкий ассортимент средств первой помощи. На всякий случай.
bulgarian: That's a great idea! Our first aid supplies should cover all the bases.

english: Excellent, I'll get to work.
french: Parfait, je me mets au travail.
russian: Замечательно, пойду займусь этим.
bulgarian: Excellent, I'll get to work.

english: Here to pitch in as well, [Ari]?
french: Tu viens apporter ton aide, [Ari] ?
russian:
Ты тоже

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло помочь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Here to pitch in as well, [Ari]?

english: Many hands make light work, I'll leave you two to it.
french: À plusieurs, le travail avance vite. Je vous laisse gérer.
russian: Вместе работается веселее. Я вас оставлю.
bulgarian: Many hands make light work, I'll leave you two to it.

english: Thanks for answering my letter.
french: Merci d'avoir répondu à ma lettre.
russian:
Спасибо, что

отозвались

отозваласьотозвалсяотозвалось на письмо.
bulgarian: Thanks for answering my letter.

english: I've sent out personal requests to anyone who might be able to help us rebuild our emergency stockpile.
french: J'ai envoyé une requête à chaque personne susceptible de nous aider à reconstituer nos réserves d'urgence.
russian: Я отправила персональные запросы всем, кто может помочь с пополнением наших чрезвычайных запасов.
bulgarian: I've sent out personal requests to anyone who might be able to help us rebuild our emergency stockpile.

english: I don't like to think about what might have happened without it in the aftermath of the earthquake. Unfortunately it's pretty much used up...
french: Je n'ose pas imaginer ce qui serait arrivé après le tremblement de terre si nous n'avions pas pu piocher dedans. Malheureusement, il n'en reste plus grand-chose...
russian: Боюсь даже думать, как бы мы без них справились после землетрясения. К сожалению, теперь они на исходе...
bulgarian: I don't like to think about what might have happened without it in the aftermath of the earthquake. Unfortunately it's pretty much used up...

english: You can count on me!
french: Tu peux compter sur moi !
russian: Можешь на меня положиться!
bulgarian: You can count on me!

english: You won't believe how many berries I can donate!
french: Tu n'imagines pas combien de baies je peux donner !
russian: Ты даже не представляешь, сколько я могу насобирать вам ягод!
bulgarian: You won't believe how many berries I can donate!

english: If only we could stockpile your enthusiasm too!
french: Si seulement nous pouvions faire des réserves de ton enthousiasme !
russian: Вот бы нам запас твоего энтузиазма!
bulgarian: If only we could stockpile your enthusiasm too!

english: Your request is reasonable, but could I suggest we add a sleep aid to the list of medicines? It keeps well.
french: Ta demande est raisonnable, mais je te conseille d'ajouter des somnifères à la liste de médicaments. On n'en a jamais trop.
russian: У тебя хороший запрос, но я бы ещё предложила добавить в список лекарств снотворное. Оно хорошо хранится.
bulgarian: Your request is reasonable, but could I suggest we add a sleep aid to the list of medicines? It keeps well.

english: Why am I surprised. You're a real piece of work.
french: Bizarrement, ça ne me surprend pas. Tu es vraiment un drôle de numéro.
russian: Почему я не удивлён. Ты тот ещё фрукт.
bulgarian: Why am I surprised. You're a real piece of work.

english: Get out of here!
french: Va-t'en !
russian: Проваливай!
bulgarian: Get out of here!

english: What?
french: De quoi ?
russian: Что?
bulgarian: What?

english: Just thought you might have something you want to offload...
french: J'avais cru que tu voulais me donner quelque chose.
russian: Мне показалось, что ты хотел чем-то поделиться...
bulgarian: Just thought you might have something you want to offload...

english: Cough up the seeds Adeline gave you, March!
french: File-moi les graines qu'Adeline t'a données, March !
russian: Отдавай семена, которые тебе дала Аделина, Март!
bulgarian: Cough up the seeds Adeline gave you, March!

english: Emergency preparedness is a job for everyone, and that includes you.
french: Tout le monde doit contribuer aux réserves d'urgence, et ça vaut aussi pour toi.
russian: Подготовка к чрезвычайным ситуациям — это долг каждого, и тебя в том числе.
bulgarian: Emergency preparedness is a job for everyone, and that includes you.

english: Adeline wanted extra nails, barrel hoops, pots...
french: Adeline voulait des clous en plus, mais aussi des anneaux de cerclage pour les tonneaux, des pots...
russian: Аделина просила больше гвоздей, ободы для бочек, кастрюли...

french: Adeline m'a donné des graines quand j'ai livré ce qu'elle voulait garder en réserve et, euh...
russian: Когда я представил свою работу для чрезвычайных запасов, Аделина отсыпала мне семян... В общем, вот...
bulgarian: Adeline gave me some seeds after I turned in my part for the stockpile, and... well...

english: Not that I was expecting to be paid but...

russian: Я не рассчитывал на оплату, но...
bulgarian: Not that I was expecting to be paid but...

english: I've been putting together a brace of new barrels for it!
french: Moi, je contribue en fabriquant de nouveaux tonneaux.
russian: Я наделал ей кучу бочек!
bulgarian: I've been putting together a brace of new barrels for it!

english: Adeline told me you're pitching in for the emergency stockpile, [Ari].
french: Adeline m'a dit que tu donnais un coup de main pour reconstituer les réserves d'urgence, [Ari].
russian: Аделина рассказала мне, что ты тоже помогаешь с чрезвычайными запасами, [Ari].
bulgarian: Adeline told me you're pitching in for the emergency stockpile, [Ari].

english: On behalf of the whole town, thank you, [Ari]!
french: La ville et moi te remercions, [Ari].
russian: Благодарю тебя от имени всего города, [Ari].
bulgarian: On behalf of the whole town, thank you, [Ari]!

russian: Поэтому возьми! Спасибо ещё раз.
bulgarian: You earned these! Thank you again.

english: Enjoy.

bulgarian: Enjoy.

russian: Я ценю заботу Аделины, но думаю, что это вознаграждение гораздо нужнее подойдёт тебе, [Ari].
bulgarian: While I appreciate the thought, I think you'll get more use out of my reward from Adeline then I will, [Ari].

english: Although I'm sure her current one has less chocolate bars in it.
french: J'imagine qu'il y a bien moins de barres chocolatées dans l'actuel.
russian: Хотя сейчас, я думаю, там уже не так много шоколадок.
bulgarian: Although I'm sure her current one has less chocolate bars in it.

english: Adeline's always had a knack for emergency planning, even as a child she had a well-stocked go bag.
french: Adeline a toujours essayé d'anticiper les situations d'urgence. Petite, elle avait déjà un kit de premiers secours tout prêt.
russian: У Аделины всегда был талант к планированию чрезвычайных ситуаций. Даже в детстве у неё в сумке был запас на всякий случай.
bulgarian: Adeline's always had a knack for emergency planning, even as a child she had a well-stocked go bag.

english: We've been discussing preparing long-lasting rations to fill up the remainder of the town's food reserves.
french: Nous évoquions la possibilité de préparer des rations longue conservation pour finir de reconstituer les réserves de nourriture de la ville.
russian: Мы тут рассуждаем, получится ли заготовить долгосрочные припасы, чтобы пополнить городской запас продовольствия.
bulgarian: We've been discussing preparing long-lasting rations to fill up the remainder of the town's food reserves.

russian: Хо-хо, я не против дружеской конкуренции!
bulgarian: Oh ho, I welcome a little friendly competition!

french: Reina, tu as dit qu'il te fallait $10 fromages$ de plus pour ta recette, c'est ça ?

Если ты ещё не

пробовалапробовалпробовало делать $сыр$, воспользуйся $мельницей$.
bulgarian: If you haven't already made $Cheese$, the $Mill$ should come in handy.

english: Just get some fresh $Milk$ from your cows, bring it to the $Mill$, and before you know it you'll have as much cheese as you can carry!
french: Il te suffit de recueillir du $lait$ frais auprès de tes vaches et de l'apporter au $moulin$, tu auras plein de fromages en un rien de temps !
russian: Возьми у коров свежего $молока$, принеси на $мельницу$ — и сыра у тебя будет сколько унесёшь.
bulgarian: Just get some fresh $Milk$ from your cows, bring it to the $Mill$, and before you know it you'll have as much cheese as you can carry!

english: And how many eggs does the recipe call for again?
french: Et il te faut combien d'œufs pour ta recette, déjà ?
russian: Напомни, сколько яиц нужно было для рецепта?
bulgarian: And how many eggs does the recipe call for again?

english: $12 Eggs$ would let me mix up enough to keep the whole town fed!
french: Avec $12 œufs$, je devrais pouvoir nourrir la ville entière !
russian: $12 яиц$ нам хватит, чтобы наделать на весь город!
bulgarian: $12 Eggs$ would let me mix up enough to keep the whole town fed!

english: And I've been experimenting with the recipe. These'll be the best tasting rations in Aldaria!
french: Et je me suis entraînée à préparer cette recette. Ce seront les meilleures rations de secours de tout Aldaria !
russian: А ещё я немного поэкспериментировала с рецептом. Это будет самый вкусный запас провизии в Альдарии!
bulgarian: And I've been experimenting with the recipe. These'll be the best tasting rations in Aldaria!

english: Well now! Maybe make a few extra for us hard-working volunteers?
french: Voyez-vous ça ! Tu en prépareras quelques-unes de plus pour les bénévoles qui se tuent à la tâche ?
russian: Ну и ну! Может, сделаешь нам добавки за добровольную помощь?
bulgarian: Well now! Maybe make a few extra for us hard-working volunteers?

english: Of course!
french: Bien sûr !
russian: Ну разумеется!
bulgarian: Of course!

english: I'll set up the $Donation Box$... hmm. Would outside the Inn work, Reina?
french: Je vais installer une $boîte de dons$. Mmm... Reina, ça irait à l'extérieur de l'auberge ?
russian: Я поставлю $ящик для пожертвований$... Хмм. Возле входа в трактир пойдёт, Рейна?
bulgarian: I'll set up the $Donation Box$... hmm. Would outside the Inn work, Reina?

english: Sure would!
french: Aucun problème !
russian: В самый раз!
bulgarian: Sure would!

english: And to sweeten the pot...
french: Et pour te motiver...
russian: А чтобы лучше работалось...
bulgarian: And to sweeten the pot...

english: How about I throw in some cosmetics for your hard working chickens and cows as a reward, [Ari]?
french: Si j'ajoutais quelques jolis accessoires pour récompenser tes bêtes qui vont travailler dur, [Ari] ?
russian: Давай-ка я добавлю в награду украшений для твоих рабочих курочек и коров, [Ari].
bulgarian: How about I throw in some cosmetics for your hard working chickens and cows as a reward, [Ari]?

english: Gya ha ha!
french: Gah ha ha !
russian: Га-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Gya ha ha!

english: It's a tall order!
french: Ça ne sera pas une mince affaire !
russian: Это большое дело!
bulgarian: It's a tall order!

english: I'm happy to help with the cooking, but I need the ingredients.
french: Je m'occuperai de la préparation avec plaisir, mais il me faudra les ingrédients.
russian: Я с удовольствием помогу с готовкой, но мне нужны ингредиенты.
bulgarian: I'm happy to help with the cooking, but I need the ingredients.

english: The Inn has been positively bustling now that the earthquake damage is repaired. I can't have our regulars go hungry!
french: L'auberge ne désemplit pas depuis que les stigmates du tremblement de terre ont été réparés. Je ne peux pas faire faux bond à mes habitués !
russian: После того, как ущерб от землетрясения устранили, в трактире всегда много народу. Нельзя, чтобы наши постоянные клиенты голодали!
bulgarian: The Inn has been positively bustling now that the earthquake damage is repaired. I can't have our regulars go hungry!

english: You know I'll give as much as I can spare for the town, Adeline.
french: Tu sais que je donnerais tout ce que je peux pour la ville, Adeline.
russian: Ты ведь знаешь, Аделина: я готов отдать ради города всё, что у меня есть.
bulgarian: You know I'll give as much as I can spare for the town, Adeline.

english: But I'm afraid my flock and herd are already at capacity. I don't think we can cover your whole request.
french: Malheureusement, je ne peux pas demander plus à mes bêtes. Je ne suis pas en mesure de fournir tout ce que tu demandes.
russian: Но, к сожалению, и хлев и вольер у меня уже заполнены. Боюсь, мы не сможем целиком закрыть твой запрос.
bulgarian: But I'm afraid my flock and herd are already at capacity. I don't think we can cover your whole request.

english: I've been meaning to expand the barn and get more animals but, well...
french: Je voulais agrandir la grange pour accueillir plus d'animaux, mais...
russian: Я думал о том, чтобы ещё расширить хлев и завести больше животных, но...
bulgarian: I've been meaning to expand the barn and get more animals but, well...

english: Just tell me how I can help!
french: Dites-moi ce que je peux faire pour aider !
russian: Просто скажите, как вам помочь!
bulgarian: Just tell me how I can help!

english: Moo-ve over, Hayden!
french: Meuuuh fais pas d'ombre, Hayden !
russian: Дай-ка ме-е-е, Хейден!
bulgarian: Moo-ve over, Hayden!

english: That's what I like to hear!
french: C'est ça que je veux entendre !
russian: Как приятно это слышать!
bulgarian: That's what I like to hear!

english: [Ari], welcome!
french: Bienvenue [Ari] !
russian: [Ari], добро пожаловать!
bulgarian: [Ari], welcome!

english: We're lucky to have so many talented do-it-yourselfers in Mistria to make up for it!
french: Heureusement, certains habitants de Mistria sont pleins de ressources et ils y remédieront.
russian: Нам в Мистрии повезло, что у нас есть столько умелых рукоделов!
bulgarian: We're lucky to have so many talented do-it-yourselfers in Mistria to make up for it!

english: Food supplies with a long shelf life have been in high demand since the earthquake, and I don't think that demand is going anywhere.
french: On nous demande énormément d'aliments longue conservation depuis le tremblement de terre. Hélas, nous ne sommes pas en mesure d'y répondre.
russian: После землетрясения вырос спрос на припасы, которые могут долго храниться. И, думаю, этот спрос никуда не денется.
bulgarian: Food supplies with a long shelf life have been in high demand since the earthquake, and I don't think that demand is going anywhere.

english: I offered to make some of my famous rock cakes for the cause, but Adeline turned me down. I wonder why...
french: J'ai proposé à Adeline mes fameuses briques à la sauce caillou, mais elle a refusé. Je me demande bien pourquoi...
russian: Я предложил Аделине сделать свои знаменитые каменные пирожные, но она мне отказала. Интересно, почему...
bulgarian: I offered to make some of my famous rock cakes for the cause, but Adeline turned me down. I wonder why...

english: I hear you're donating to the town food reserves, [Ari]!
french: Il paraît que tu aides à reconstituer les réserves de nourriture de la ville, [Ari] ?
russian: Я слышал, ты собираешь еду для городских запасов, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I hear you're donating to the town food reserves, [Ari]!

english: But if you had tried the old emergency rations...bleh.
french: Si tu avais goûté aux anciennes rations de secours... Beurk !
russian:
Но если бы ты

попробовали

попробовалапопробовалпопробовало еду из прошлого чрезвычайного запаса... Просто фу.

english: I'm up for the challenge!
french: En tout cas, je suis prête à relever le défi !
russian: Я лучше постараюсь!
bulgarian: I'm up for the challenge!

english: It's not easy making food last a long time and taste good.
french: C'est loin d'être facile de cuisiner des plats qui se conservent longtemps et bons au goût.
russian: Сделать еду вкусной и долго хранящейся не так-то просто.
bulgarian: It's not easy making food last a long time and taste good.

english: Almost there...
french: Ça sera bientôt prêt...
russian: Уже почти...
bulgarian: Almost there...

english: Whew!
french: Pfiou !
russian: Фух!
bulgarian: Whew!

english: Twice-baked rations, with my own secret blend of herbs and spices. Dig in!
french: Des rations double cuisson relevées de mon mélange secret d'herbes et d'épices. Allez-y, goûtez !
russian: Дважды запечённые припасы с моим фирменным набором трав и специй. Налетайте!
bulgarian: Twice-baked rations, with my own secret blend of herbs and spices. Dig in!

english: You've done it again, Reina! Superb!
french: Tu t'es encore surpassée, Reina ! C'est un délice !
russian: Ты снова на высоте, Рейна! Это превосходно!
bulgarian: You've done it again, Reina! Superb!

english: Seconds, please.
french: Il y a du rab ?
russian: Добавки, пожалуйста.
bulgarian: Seconds, please.

english: Yaaaaay!
french: Génial !
russian: Ура-а-а!
bulgarian: Yaaaaay!

english: I agree with [Ari] that they're very good, but if we eat too much now I'll have to put out another donation request!
french: Je suis d'accord avec [Ari]. C'est délicieux. Mais si nous en mangeons trop, je devrais relancer une requête !
russian:
[Ari]

правы

праваправправо насчёт отменного вкуса, но если мы всё съедим, то придётся устраивать ещё один сбор!

english: Surviving on these would be a real pleasure! Hemlock, make sure you put on a beer reserve that would pair as well.

russian: Для чрезвычайной ситуации это просто роскошь! Хемлок, не хочешь вдобавок отложить на чёрный день запас пива?
bulgarian: Surviving on these would be a real pleasure! Hemlock, make sure you put on a beer reserve that would pair as well.

english: Way ahead of you, Hayden!
french: Je ne t'ai pas attendu, Hayden !
russian: Я уже обо всём подумал, Хейден!
bulgarian: Way ahead of you, Hayden!

english: I think the whole town will be delighted to know that the next time there's trouble, Mistria will be ready!
french: Les habitants seront sûrement ravis de savoir qu'en cas de nouveau coup dur, Mistria sera prête !
russian: Думаю, все в городе обрадуются, когда узнают, что теперь Мистрия будет готова, когда придёт беда!
bulgarian: I think the whole town will be delighted to know that the next time there's trouble, Mistria will be ready!

english: Keep an eye on that stove, Dad!
french: Ne quitte pas le feu des yeux, papa !
russian: Следи за плитой, папа!
bulgarian: Keep an eye on that stove, Dad!

english: With the reserves filling up, Adeline has dropped those meetings!
french: Maintenant que les réserves sont pleines, Adeline a annulé les autres réunions prévues à ce sujet !

bulgarian: With the reserves filling up, Adeline has dropped those meetings!

english: I need to thank you, [Ari]. You wouldn't believe the meetings Adeline and I had to try and figure out what to do if another disaster hit Mistria.
french: Je tiens à te remercier, [Ari]. Tu n'imagines pas toutes ces réunions passées à essayer de savoir quoi faire en cas de nouveau coup dur.
russian: Я должен тебя поблагодарить, [Ari]. Ты не поверишь, сколько у нас с Аделиной было совещаний о том, что делать, если в Мистрии случится ещё одна катастрофа.
bulgarian: I need to thank you, [Ari]. You wouldn't believe the meetings Adeline and I had to try and figure out what to do if another disaster hit Mistria.

english: Too bad we didn't come up with a better name for them though...
french: Dommage que nous n'ayons pas trouvé un nom plus appétissant pour ce plat...
russian: Жаль только, что мы не придумали название получше...
bulgarian: Too bad we didn't come up with a better name for them though...

english: Did you hear, [Ari]? Everyone liked those rations so much that we added them to the menu at the Inn!
french: Tu es au courant, [Ari] ? Les rations de secours ont tellement de succès que nous les avons ajoutées à la carte de l'auberge !
russian:
Ты уже

слышали

слышаласлышалслышало, [Ari]? Эти припасы так всем понравились, что мы решили добавить их в меню!
bulgarian: Did you hear, [Ari]? Everyone liked those rations so much that we added them to the menu at the Inn!

english: Taste testing!
french: Celle où on goûte les plats !
russian: Дегустация!
bulgarian: Taste testing!

english: Hey, [Ari]! If you've turned in everything for the food reserves, it's time for the next step!
french: Bonjour [Ari] ! Si tu as rempli ta part pour ce qui est des réserves de nourriture, passons à l'étape suivante...
russian:
Привет, [Ari]! Если ты

приготовили

приготовилаприготовилприготовило всё для запасов продовольствия, то пора перейти к следующему этапу!

english: Hoho, I can see you've brought [Ari]! Your proposal must have really caught Adeline's attention, Ryis!

russian: Хо-хо, вижу, что и [Ari] будет с нами! Тебе явно удалось заинтересовать Аделину своим предложением, Риз!
bulgarian: Hoho, I can see you've brought [Ari]! Your proposal must have really caught Adeline's attention, Ryis!

english: I thought that'd catch your interest! Tell you what, when we're done, I'll throw in a $Small Greenhouse Blueprint$ for free.
french: J'étais sûr que ça allait t'intéresser ! D'ailleurs, quand on aura terminé, je t'offrirai un $plan de petite serre$.
russian: Я знал, что ты заинтересуешься! Знаешь что, когда закончим, я дам тебе $чертёж маленького парника$ бесплатно.
bulgarian: I thought that'd catch your interest! Tell you what, when we're done, I'll throw in a $Small Greenhouse Blueprint$ for free.

english: And we can cover all of the ordinary materials, since we have some in stock.
french: Et nous pouvons fournir tous les matériaux de base, puisque nous les avons en stock.
russian: И мы предоставим все обычные материалы, они ведь есть у нас в продаже.
bulgarian: And we can cover all of the ordinary materials, since we have some in stock.

english: Thank you, Ryis!
french: Merci, Ryis !
russian: Спасибо, Риз!
bulgarian: Thank you, Ryis!
