russian: Итак, рада сообщить, что благодаря недавним улучшениям благосостояния Мистрии городская казна наконец-то в плюсе!
bulgarian: Now, I'm delighted to report that Mistria's recent turnaround has meant the town's coffers are finally in the black!

english: A larger, more advanced Carpenter's Shop benefits the whole town, so we're happy to cover the tesserae costs.
french: Une menuiserie plus grande et plus développée bénéficiera à toute la ville. Nous couvrirons les dépenses nécessaires.
russian: Большая и хорошо оснащённая столярная мастерская будет полезна всему городу, так что мы готовы покрыть расходы в тессерах.
bulgarian: A larger, more advanced Carpenter's Shop benefits the whole town, so we're happy to cover the tesserae costs.

english: [Ari], if you could handle gathering $100 Refined Stone$, $100 Glass$, $30 Crystal$, and $30 Obsidian$, we'd have all we need.
french: [Ari], si tu pouvais t'occuper de récolter $100 pierres affinées$, $100 morceaux de verre$, $30 cristaux$ et $30 fragments d'obsidienne$, nous aurions tout ce qu'il nous faut.
russian: [Ari], если ты сможешь собрать $100 плиточного камня$, $100 стекла$, $30 кристаллов$ и $30 обсидиана$, у нас будет всё, что нужно.
bulgarian: [Ari], if you could handle gathering $100 Refined Stone$, $100 Glass$, $30 Crystal$, and $30 Obsidian$, we'd have all we need.

english: You can count on me!
french: Tu peux compter sur moi !
russian: Можете на меня рассчитывать!
bulgarian: You can count on me!

english: Of course! Lucky we built that Stone Refinery, huh?
french: Bien sûr ! Heureusement qu'on a construit l'affinerie, hein ?
russian: Разумеется! Хорошо, что мы построили камнетёсную установку.
bulgarian: Of course! Lucky we built that Stone Refinery, huh?

english: Yahoo!
french: Merveilleux !
russian: Ура!
bulgarian: Yahoo!

english: Who needs luck when we've got you in town, [Ari]?
french: Depuis ton arrivée, nous n'avons plus à compter uniquement sur la chance, [Ari] !
russian: Зачем полагаться на удачу, когда у нас есть [Ari]?
bulgarian: Who needs luck when we've got you in town, [Ari]?

english: Wonderful! I'll put the $Donation Box$ right outside the Carpenter's Shop. Then when you're done come talk to me!
french: Très bien ! Je vais placer la $boîte de dons$ juste à l'extérieur de la menuiserie. Viens me voir quand tu auras terminé de tout récolter !
russian: Чудесно! Я поставлю $ящик для пожертвований$ рядом со входом в столярную мастерскую. Когда всё соберёшь, приходи и сообщи мне.
bulgarian: Wonderful! I'll put the $Donation Box$ right outside the Carpenter's Shop. Then when you're done come talk to me!

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: En tout cas, merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: Well, really it's [Ari]'s fault.
french: Tout ça, c'est grâce à [Ari].
russian:
Ну, вообще-то, это [Ari]

виноваты

виноватавиноватвиновато.
bulgarian: Well, really it's [Ari]'s fault.

english: Mistria's town rank has been shooting up and the projects have been quickly getting more complex.
french: Mistria a très vite grimpé au classement des villes et les projets deviennent de plus en plus complexes.
russian: Ранг Мистрии буквально взлетел вверх, и проекты стали приходить всё более сложные.
bulgarian: Mistria's town rank has been shooting up and the projects have been quickly getting more complex.

english: Those fancy schmancy vendor booths really caught us off guard!
french: Ces demandes de stands tape-à-l'œil nous ont pris au dépourvu !
russian: Эти модники-торговцы со своими щегольскими киосками застали нас врасплох!
bulgarian: Those fancy schmancy vendor booths really caught us off guard!

english: Nothing we couldn't handle of course, but we had to do some improvising.
french: Bien entendu, on s'en est sortis, mais il a fallu improviser.
russian: Мы, конечно, со всем справились, но пришлось импровизировать.
bulgarian: Nothing we couldn't handle of course, but we had to do some improvising.

english: So I talked it over with my uncle, and we submitted a blueprint for a new addition to the shop to Adeline.
french: Après avoir discuté avec mon oncle, j'ai proposé à Adeline un plan d'extension pour la menuiserie.
russian: В общем, я обсудил всё с дядей, и мы подали Аделине проект по расширению мастерской.
bulgarian: So I talked it over with my uncle, and we submitted a blueprint for a new addition to the shop to Adeline.

english: It was very comprehensive! You two certainly made a powerful case.
french: C'était très complet ! Vous aviez vraiment de bons arguments à faire valoir, tous les deux.
russian: Очень детальный проект! Вы вдвоём приводите крайне убедительные аргументы.
bulgarian: It was very comprehensive! You two certainly made a powerful case.

english: I'll spare you busy folks all the technical details, but it'll let us take on big new custom orders!
french: Tout le monde est très occupé, je vous épargnerai donc tous les détails techniques, mais cela nous permettra d'accepter de nouvelles grosses commandes sur mesure !
russian: Вы у нас такие занятые, так что не буду вас утруждать техническими подробностями. Расширение позволит нам брать более крупные и сложные заказы!
bulgarian: I'll spare you busy folks all the technical details, but it'll let us take on big new custom orders!

english: A larger workshop would mean that a $second story upgrade on your house$ would be possible, and we'd be able to start selling $Greenhouse$ blueprints.
french: Avec un atelier plus grand, nous pourrions $ajouter un étage à ta maison$, et nous pourrions aussi vendre des plans pour construire des $serres$.
russian: Большая мастерская откроет возможность $достроить к твоему дому второй этаж$. А ещё мы сможем продавать чертежи $парников$.
bulgarian: A larger workshop would mean that a $second story upgrade on your house$ would be possible, and we'd be able to start selling $Greenhouse$ blueprints.

english: So I could start growing crops out of season?
french: Ça veut dire que je pourrai lancer des cultures hors de la saison habituelle ?
russian: И я смогу выращивать растения вне сезона?
bulgarian: So I could start growing crops out of season?

english: A Greenhouse would look great on my farm...
french: Une serre, ça ferait joli, dans ma ferme...
russian: $Парник$ неплохо будет смотреться на моей ферме...
bulgarian: A Greenhouse would look great on my farm...

english: Hey, [Ari]! We're in the back, come on in!
french: Hé, [Ari] ! On est dans l'arrière-boutique, entre !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Мы тут, сзади, заходи!
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]! We're in the back, come on in!

english: But just thinking about expanding the workshop... all that extra space and new tools...
french: Mais quand je pense à l'extension de la menuiserie... à tout cet espace en plus et à tous ces nouveaux outils...
russian: Но как только вспоминаю про расширение мастерской... столько свободного места и новых инструментов...
bulgarian: But just thinking about expanding the workshop... all that extra space and new tools...

english: My hands get itchy just thinking about all the projects I could take on!
french: J'en ai des picotements dans les mains en imaginant tous les projets que je pourrais réaliser !
russian: У меня руки чешутся, когда я думаю, какие проекты мог бы там сделать!
bulgarian: My hands get itchy just thinking about all the projects I could take on!

english: I know, I know, I'm retired.
french: Je sais, je sais, je suis censé être à la retraite.
russian: Знаю, знаю, я на пенсии.
bulgarian: I know, I know, I'm retired.

english: Here, for the $Donation Box$. Don't tell Ryis, okay?
french: Tiens, mets ça dans la $boîte de dons$. Et ne dis rien à Ryis, d'accord ?
russian: Вот, это для $ящика для пожертвований$. Не говори Ризу, ладно?
bulgarian: Here, for the $Donation Box$. Don't tell Ryis, okay?

english: Ryis won't stop talking about all the exciting new projects he could do if his shop gets that expansion.
french: Ryis n'arrête pas de parler de tous les nouveaux projets passionnants qu'il pourrait réaliser grâce à l'extension de la menuiserie.
russian: Риз всё время болтает о потрясающих новых проектах, которые он сможет сделать, если мастерскую расширить.
bulgarian: Ryis won't stop talking about all the exciting new projects he could do if his shop gets that expansion.

english: I'm excited about the shop expansion, but take your time okay, [Ari]?
french: C'est vrai que j'ai très hâte de voir la menuiserie agrandie, mais prends ton temps, d'accord [Ari] ?
russian: Я уже предвкушаю расширение мастерской, но ты не спеши, [Ari], хорошо?
bulgarian: I'm excited about the shop expansion, but take your time okay, [Ari]?

english: Nicely done everyone!
french: Beau travail, tout le monde !
russian: Отлично поработали, ребята!
bulgarian: Nicely done everyone!

english: Wonderful work, all of you! I haven't seen a finer workshop anywhere in Aldaria.
french: Merci pour tous vos efforts ! Je n'ai jamais vu plus bel atelier dans tout Aldaria !
russian: Какие вы все молодцы! Я во всей Альдарии не видела такой прекрасной мастерской.
bulgarian: Wonderful work, all of you! I haven't seen a finer workshop anywhere in Aldaria.

english: Here's that $Small Greenhouse Blueprint$, [Ari]. And thank you again, for everything.
french: Voilà le $plan de petite serre$ que je t'avais promis, [Ari]. Et encore merci pour tout.
russian: Вот $чертёж маленького парника$, о котором я говорил, [Ari]. И ещё раз спасибо тебе за всё.
bulgarian: Here's that $Small Greenhouse Blueprint$, [Ari]. And thank you again, for everything.

english: And feel free to swing on by if you want to see the rest of the new projects we can offer now!
french: N'hésite pas à passer si tu veux voir tous les nouveaux projets que nous pouvons réaliser dorénavant !
russian: Заходи к нам, когда будет удобно: посмотришь на остальные проекты, которые у нас появились!
bulgarian: And feel free to swing on by if you want to see the rest of the new projects we can offer now!

english: Whew!
french: Pfiou !
russian: Фух!
bulgarian: Whew!

english: I love gardening outdoors, but it's awfully tempting...
french: J'adore jardiner en plein air, mais c'est tout de même très tentant...
russian: Я люблю работать на улице, но всё равно звучит очень заманчиво...
bulgarian: I love gardening outdoors, but it's awfully tempting...

english: I could grow all my favorite flowers out of season!
french: Je pourrais faire pousser toutes mes fleurs préférées à n'importe quelle saison !
russian: Я могла бы выращивать свои любимые цветы в любое время года!
bulgarian: I could grow all my favorite flowers out of season!

english: Did you hear that the Carpenter's Shop is selling Greenhouses now?
french: Tu as entendu que la menuiserie pouvait te construire une serre, maintenant ?
russian:
Ты

слышали

слышаласлышалслышало, что в столярной мастерской теперь продаются парники?
bulgarian: Did you hear that the Carpenter's Shop is selling Greenhouses now?

english: So I made you a =Vegetable Pot Pie=! Go on, take it!
french: Pour te remercier, je t'ai préparé une =tourte aux légumes= ! Tiens !
russian: И я решил приготовить для тебя =овощной пирог=! Вот, возьми!
bulgarian: So I made you a =Vegetable Pot Pie=! Go on, take it!

english: I know I've already thanked you, [Ari] but well, you've really gone above and beyond for Ryis and myself...
french: Je sais que je t'ai déjà dit merci, [Ari], mais tu ne t'es clairement pas ménagé<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> pour Ryis et moi...
russian:
Я знаю, что мы тебя уже благодарили, [Ari], но, в общем, ты ведь изо всех сил

постарались

постараласьпостаралсяпостаралось ради нас с Ризом...
bulgarian: I know I've already thanked you, [Ari] but well, you've really gone above and beyond for Ryis and myself...

english: After all the projects he's been helping us out on, I thought he already had!
french: Après tous les coups de main qu'il nous a donnés récemment, je croyais que c'était déjà le cas !
russian: Учитывая, сколько проектов он нам уже помог сделать, я думал, он давно вернулся!
bulgarian: After all the projects he's been helping us out on, I thought he already had!

english: With the extra room at the shop now, Uncle Landen has been talking about coming out of retirement again.
french: Vu tout l'espace en plus dans l'atelier, oncle Landen se dit à nouveau qu'il va arrêter la retraite et se remettre au travail.
russian: В новой мастерской стало так много места, что дядя Ланден говорит, что может уйти с пенсии и вернуться к работе.
bulgarian: With the extra room at the shop now, Uncle Landen has been talking about coming out of retirement again.

english: Ooh, Ryis and Landen will be so excited! Come on, let's get started!
french: Oh, Ryis et Landen vont être ravis ! Allez, on s'y met !
russian: Ух, Риз и Ланден так обрадуются! Ладно, давай приступим!
bulgarian: Ooh, Ryis and Landen will be so excited! Come on, let's get started!

english: A letter arrived from the $Aldarian Merchant's Guild$, Nora.
french: Nous avons reçu une lettre de la $guilde des marchands d'Aldaria$, Nora.
russian: Пришло письмо из $Альдарийской гильдии торговцев$, Нора.
bulgarian: A letter arrived from the $Aldarian Merchant's Guild$, Nora.

english: And uh... $Wheedle$. He's apparently very high up in the Merchant's Guild, specializing in $extremely high-end goods$.
french: Et le deuxième, c'est, hum... $Wheedle$. Apparemment, il a un poste très élevé au sein de la guilde des marchands. Sa spécialité, ce sont les $produits très haut de gamme$.
russian: И эмм... $Хлюст$. Оказывается, он важная персона в гильдии торговцев. Его профиль — $самые элитные товары$.
bulgarian: And uh... $Wheedle$. He's apparently very high up in the Merchant's Guild, specializing in $extremely high-end goods$.

english: You're right, I have heard about them. Supposedly, they're both real characters.
french: Tu as raison. Je le connais de nom. De ce que je sais, ils ont tous deux de fortes personnalités.
russian: Действительно, я о них наслышана. Говорят, у них обоих так себе характер.
bulgarian: You're right, I have heard about them. Supposedly, they're both real characters.

english: But I shouldn't let rumors stand in the way of letting everyone in Mistria enjoy their booths.
french: Mais ne laissons pas les rumeurs empêcher les habitants de Mistria de profiter de leurs stands.
russian: Но я не хочу мешать мистрийцам посещать их лавки из-за слухов.
bulgarian: But I shouldn't let rumors stand in the way of letting everyone in Mistria enjoy their booths.

english: I feel the same way.
french: C'est ce que je me dis aussi.
russian: Я тоже так считаю.
bulgarian: I feel the same way.

english: Now, the Capital will be covering their traveling expenses...
french: Bien, c'est la capitale qui paiera leurs déplacements...
russian: Итак, в столице оплатят их транспортные расходы...
bulgarian: Now, the Capital will be covering their traveling expenses...

english: And before you worry about it Nora, I volunteer the front lawn of the Manor House for them to set up their booths.
french: Et avant que tu ne poses la question Nora, je mettrai à leur disposition les pelouses devant le manoir pour qu'ils s'y installent.
russian: И не волнуйся о размещении, Нора: я предоставлю для них площадку перед фасадом особняка.
bulgarian: And before you worry about it Nora, I volunteer the front lawn of the Manor House for them to set up their booths.

english: But the Merchant's Guild has sent along... er, exacting requirements for the construction of their booths, which Mistria needs to cover.
french: Par contre, la guilde des marchands a également envoyé, euh... des instructions très précises pour la construction de leurs étals, et c'est à Mistria d'en assumer les frais.
russian: Но гильдия торговцев прислала с письмом, эм... крайне суровые требования, чтобы соорудить их лавки, которые оплачиваются за счёт Мистрии.
bulgarian: But the Merchant's Guild has sent along... er, exacting requirements for the construction of their booths, which Mistria needs to cover.

english: Let me see...
french: Voyons voir...
russian: Давай посмотрим...
bulgarian: Let me see...

english: $Gold Ingots$? For a market booth?!
french: Des $lingots d'or$ ? Pour des stands ?!
russian: $Слитки золота$? Для лавки на базаре?!
bulgarian: $Gold Ingots$? For a market booth?!

english: These numbers are unfortunately after I negotiated them down... they were even worse initially...
french: Hélas, ce sont les chiffres après négociations... Ils étaient bien plus élevés au départ.
russian: К сожалению, это — цифры уже после того, как я с ними поторговалась... Вначале они были ещё хуже...
bulgarian: These numbers are unfortunately after I negotiated them down... they were even worse initially...

english: That is big news!
french: Quelle grande nouvelle !
russian: Это серьёзная новость!
bulgarian: That is big news!

english: There's enough in the Market coffers to take this down by another 20%, but even then it's outrageous.
french: Les réserves du marché peuvent absorber 20 % des coûts, mais cela reste exorbitant.
russian: Из выручки базара мы можем покрыть ещё 20%, но даже так остаётся неподъёмная сумма.
bulgarian: There's enough in the Market coffers to take this down by another 20%, but even then it's outrageous.

english: I suppose the Saturday Market doesn't need to have an upgrade this year... or this decade...
french: Bien, le marché du samedi se passera d'améliorations cette année... Voire les dix prochaines années.
russian: Видимо, Субботний базар обойдётся без расширения в ближайший год... или десять лет...
bulgarian: I suppose the Saturday Market doesn't need to have an upgrade this year... or this decade...

english: If the Saturday Market needs a helping hand, it's got mine!
french: Si le marché du samedi a besoin d'un coup de pouce, je suis là !
russian:
Если Субботнему базару нужна помощь, то я

готовы

готоваготовготово!
bulgarian: If the Saturday Market needs a helping hand, it's got mine!

english: If it'll get my old pal Wheedle back in town, count me in!
french: Si ça permet à mon vieux copain Wheedle de revenir en ville, comptez sur moi !
russian: Я помогу, если это поможет вернуть моего старого дружка Хлюста!
bulgarian: If it'll get my old pal Wheedle back in town, count me in!

english: Oh, [Ari]! Thank you!
french: Oh, [Ari] ! Merci !
russian: Ого, [Ari]! Спасибо!
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! Thank you!

english: I... I didn't know you and Wheedle were such good friends! In any case...
french: Je... Je ne savais pas que vous vous connaissiez si bien, Wheedle et toi ! Quoi qu'il en soit...
russian: Я... не знала, что вы с Хлюстом так хорошо дружите! В любом случае...
bulgarian: I... I didn't know you and Wheedle were such good friends! In any case...

english: We'll need $8 Gold Ingots$, $20 Obsidian$, $20 Crystal$, $100 Hard Wood$, and $50 Refined Stone$.
french: Nous aurons besoin de $8 lingots d'or$, de $20 fragments d'obsidienne$, de $20 cristaux$, de $100 rondins de bois dur$ et de $50 pierres affinées$.
russian: Нам нужно $8 слитков золота$, $20 обсидиана$, $20 кристаллов$, $100 твёрдой древесины$ и $50 плиточного камня$.
bulgarian: We'll need $8 Gold Ingots$, $20 Obsidian$, $20 Crystal$, $100 Hard Wood$, and $50 Refined Stone$.

english: You're a lifesaver, [Ari].
french: Tu nous sauves la mise, [Ari].
russian: Ты нас выручаешь, [Ari].
bulgarian: You're a lifesaver, [Ari].

english: I'll set up the $Donation Box$ outside the Manor House.
french: Je vais installer la $boîte de dons$ à l'extérieur du manoir.
russian: Я поставлю рядом с особняком $ящик для пожертвований$.
bulgarian: I'll set up the $Donation Box$ outside the Manor House.

english: The $Aldarian Merchant's Guild$ handles all the business in the Capital, as well as any incoming and outgoing shipments in the country.
french: La $guilde des marchands d'Aldaria$ chapeaute tous les commerces de la capitale et supervise la réception et l'expédition des marchandises.
russian: $Альдарийская гильдия торговцев$ заведует всей столичной торговлей, а также всеми импортом и экспортом в стране.
bulgarian: The $Aldarian Merchant's Guild$ handles all the business in the Capital, as well as any incoming and outgoing shipments in the country.

english: A little place like Mistria would normally be beneath their notice.
french: Une petite ville comme Mistria ne devrait normalement pas attirer leur attention.
russian: Обычно они не обращают внимания на маленькие местечки вроде Мистрии.
bulgarian: A little place like Mistria would normally be beneath their notice.

english: They're impressed with how successful our $Saturday Market$ has become, and with how high our town rank has risen.
french: Ils sont très impressionnés par le succès de notre $marché du samedi$ ainsi que par notre place au classement des villes.
russian: Они впечатлены успехами нашего $Субботнего базара$ и ростом ранга Мистрии.
bulgarian: They're impressed with how successful our $Saturday Market$ has become, and with how high our town rank has risen.

english: In fact, they're so impressed, they're considering adding Mistria to the weekly travel routes of $two of their top vendors$!
french: À tel point qu'ils songent à ajouter Mistria aux tournées hebdomadaires de $deux de leurs meilleurs vendeurs$ !
russian: Более того, они настолько впечатлены, что собираются добавить Мистрию в еженедельный торговый маршрут $двух своих лучших торговцев$!
bulgarian: In fact, they're so impressed, they're considering adding Mistria to the weekly travel routes of $two of their top vendors$!

english: That's- That's incredible! Anyone I'd know?
french: C'est... C'est incroyable ! Je les connais ?
russian: Это... Просто невероятно! Кто-то из них мне знаком?
bulgarian: That's- That's incredible! Anyone I'd know?

english: I think you'll recognize both their names.
french: Je crois qu'aucun de ces deux noms ne te sera inconnu.
russian: Я думаю, ты знаешь обоих.
bulgarian: I think you'll recognize both their names.

english: First up is $Taliferro$, he's the Royal Chef whose $Cooking Challenge$ booth has been a huge hit across Aldaria.
french: Le premier, c'est $Taliferro$, le cuisinier royal. Son stand de $défis gastronomiques$ rencontre un succès fou dans tout Aldaria.
russian: Во-первых, $Талиферро$, придворный шеф. $Смотр блюд$ в его лавке — настоящий хит по всей Альдарии.
bulgarian: First up is $Taliferro$, he's the Royal Chef whose $Cooking Challenge$ booth has been a huge hit across Aldaria.

english: What's this all about, Adeline? I haven't seen you this excited since we got in that special order of colored pens.
french: Que se passe-t-il, Adeline ? Je ne t'ai pas vue aussi enthousiaste depuis que nous avons reçu cette commande spéciale de surligneurs de toutes les couleurs.
russian: В чём дело, Аделина? По-моему, в последний раз ты была так взволнована, когда привезли твой заказ цветных ручек.
bulgarian: What's this all about, Adeline? I haven't seen you this excited since we got in that special order of colored pens.

english: Ryis and I are going to make the best booths they've ever seen!
french: Ryis et moi allons leur construire des stands comme ils n'en ont jamais vu auparavant !
russian: Мы с Ризом построим им такие лавки, каких они в жизни не видали!
bulgarian: Ryis and I are going to make the best booths they've ever seen!

english: There you are! Thank you so much for helping out with those goofy requirements for those snooty Capital vendors.
french: Te voilà ! Merci de nous aider à répondre aux exigences ridicules de ces commerçants prétentieux de la capitale.
russian:
Вот ты где! Спасибо тебе огромное, что

помогли

помоглапомогпомогло выполнить эти дурацкие требования столичных задир.
bulgarian: There you are! Thank you so much for helping out with those goofy requirements for those snooty Capital vendors.

english: I'm looking forward to working on the new vendor booths.
french: J'ai hâte de me mettre aux stands de ces nouveaux vendeurs.
russian: Мне уже не терпится приступить к лавкам для этих новых торговцев.
bulgarian: I'm looking forward to working on the new vendor booths.

english: Never thought I'd see the day where a town project required me to do gold ornamentation work...
french: Je ne pensais pas un jour voir un projet pour la ville qui nécessiterait des fioritures en or...
russian: Не думал, что настанет день, когда для городского проекта потребуется орнамент из золота...
bulgarian: Never thought I'd see the day where a town project required me to do gold ornamentation work...

english: It's such a big milestone for the town!
french: C'est une étape très importante pour la ville !
russian: Это очень важный этап для развития города!
bulgarian: It's such a big milestone for the town!

english: I can't thank you enough for helping out with these market booths, [Ari].
french: Je ne sais pas comment te remercier de nous aider à la réalisation de ces stands, [Ari].
russian: Не могу выразить, как я тебе благодарна за помощь с новыми лавками, [Ari].
bulgarian: I can't thank you enough for helping out with these market booths, [Ari].

english: It's a really exciting project! I've roped in March to help with the gold ornamentation, he loves working on that kind of thing.
french: C'est un projet super intéressant ! J'ai demandé à March qu'il nous aide pour les décorations en or. C'est le genre de trucs qu'il aime.
russian: Это такой интересный проект! Я привлёк Марта, чтобы он сделал золотые орнаменты. Он обожает такую тонкую работу.
bulgarian: It's a really exciting project! I've roped in March to help with the gold ornamentation, he loves working on that kind of thing.

english: Landen and I have been working on the new vendor booth's blueprints.
french: Landen et moi avons mis au point les plans pour les stands des nouveaux vendeurs.
russian: Мы с Ланденом готовим чертежи для лавок новых торговцев.
bulgarian: Landen and I have been working on the new vendor booth's blueprints.

english: I'll let Ryis know, I'm sure he and Landen are raring to go.
french: Je vais avertir Ryis. Je suis certaine que lui et Landen ont très hâte de s'y mettre.
russian: Я сообщу Ризу. Уверена, им с Ланденом уже не терпится приступить.
bulgarian: I'll let Ryis know, I'm sure he and Landen are raring to go.

english: We should be able to get everything ready for the new vendors to join us on $Saturday$!
french: Tout devrait être fin prêt pour que les vendeurs exposent dès $samedi$ !
russian: К $субботе$ мы должны успеть всё приготовить для новых продавцов!
bulgarian: We should be able to get everything ready for the new vendors to join us on $Saturday$!

english: You've gathered all the materials for the new Saturday Market vendors? Incredible work, [Ari]!
french: Tu as tous les matériaux pour les nouveaux stands du marché du samedi ? Tu es incroyable, [Ari] !
russian:
Ты

собрали

собраласобралсобрало все материалы для новых лавок Субботнего базара? Потрясающая работа, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You've gathered all the materials for the new Saturday Market vendors? Incredible work, [Ari]!

english: [Ari]! I can't wait to tell you all about the news. Come on!
french: [Ari] ! J'ai tellement hâte de te raconter les dernières nouvelles. Viens !
russian: [Ari]! Есть одна новость, я так хочу тебе рассказать! Пойдём!
bulgarian: [Ari]! I can't wait to tell you all about the news. Come on!

english: Such a long list of potential vendors! It's certainly flattering.
bulgarian: Such a long list of potential vendors! It's certainly flattering.

english: First off is Zorel, she's a popular musician from the Capital.
bulgarian: First off is Zorel, she's a popular musician from the Capital.

english: I'll say she is! My sisters wrote to me about attending one of her shows last year. And she wants to open up a vendor booth?
bulgarian: I'll say she is! My sisters wrote to me about attending one of her shows last year. And she wants to open up a vendor booth?

english: That's right. She's selling $Song Crystals$ that play music when placed inside a special device called a $Crystal Resonator$.
bulgarian: That's right. She's selling $Song Crystals$ that play music when placed inside a special device called a $Crystal Resonator$.

english: I don't pretend to understand it, but she's passionate about them and wants to spread them across Aldaria.
bulgarian: I don't pretend to understand it, but she's passionate about them and wants to spread them across Aldaria.

english: In close second is Stillwell. He's a fortune teller-
bulgarian: In close second is Stillwell. He's a fortune teller-

english: Oh please.
bulgarian: Oh please.

english: Well, whatever your personal opinions are about fortune telling, he's VERY popular. Even my parents have been to see him.
bulgarian: Well, whatever your personal opinions are about fortune telling, he's VERY popular. Even my parents have been to see him.

english: In his application he writes that it's "vitally important" he be given a booth here.
bulgarian: In his application he writes that it's "vitally important" he be given a booth here.

english: If nothing else, I believe he could be a big draw. People travel from all over Aldaria to see him in the Capital.
bulgarian: If nothing else, I believe he could be a big draw. People travel from all over Aldaria to see him in the Capital.

english: So we just gotta find a place for their booths, huh...
bulgarian: So we just gotta find a place for their booths, huh...

english: But Nora's right. There just isn't any space left in the town square to accommodate more booths...
bulgarian: But Nora's right. There just isn't any space left in the town square to accommodate more booths...

english: I volunteer my room!
bulgarian: I volunteer my room!

english: Noted.
bulgarian: Noted.

english: Does anyone else have any other ideas?
bulgarian: Does anyone else have any other ideas?

english: What about that rise of land west of the Blacksmith's Shop?
bulgarian: What about that rise of land west of the Blacksmith's Shop?

english: March and I have already talked about how nice a little plaza would be up there if it was cleaned up.
bulgarian: March and I have already talked about how nice a little plaza would be up there if it was cleaned up.

english: That's a great idea! We never had the time before, but I think we could manage it now.
bulgarian: That's a great idea! We never had the time before, but I think we could manage it now.

english: It seems we're all in agreement!
bulgarian: It seems we're all in agreement!

english: I'll start running the numbers, it won't be cheap to build a whole new plaza...
bulgarian: I'll start running the numbers, it won't be cheap to build a whole new plaza...

english: You know you can count on me!
bulgarian: You know you can count on me!

english: A new plaza and new vendors? I'm in!
bulgarian: A new plaza and new vendors? I'm in!

english: I'm so glad we can always count on you, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'm so glad we can always count on you, [Ari].

english: The whole town will certainly benefit!
bulgarian: The whole town will certainly benefit!

english: Adeline... what would you say to calling an impromptu meeting with the Carpenters and Blacksmiths?
bulgarian: Adeline... what would you say to calling an impromptu meeting with the Carpenters and Blacksmiths?

english: Whoa whoa whoa!
bulgarian: Whoa whoa whoa!

english: Now [Ari], you've done your share and then some. Let us take our share of the load!
bulgarian: Now [Ari], you've done your share and then some. Let us take our share of the load!

english: Yeah! Your laurels need resting or they're going to get worn out.
bulgarian: Yeah! Your laurels need resting or they're going to get worn out.

english: I don't know if I agree with Olric's phrasing, but I agree to his sentiment.
bulgarian: I don't know if I agree with Olric's phrasing, but I agree to his sentiment.

english: Yeah, [Ari]. You leave the plaza to us!
bulgarian: Yeah, [Ari]. You leave the plaza to us!

english: Quick everyone! Let's get started right now, or else [Ari] will sneak in somehow!
bulgarian: Quick everyone! Let's get started right now, or else [Ari] will sneak in somehow!

english: That does sound like <he>him</he><she>her</she><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none>...
bulgarian: That does sound like <he>him</he><she>her</she><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>[Ari]</none>...

english: I call dibs on breaking all the rocks!
bulgarian: I call dibs on breaking all the rocks!

english: Weren't they enthusiastic!
bulgarian: Weren't they enthusiastic!

english: But I still want to help...
bulgarian: But I still want to help...

english: Guess my time to shine is over...
bulgarian: Guess my time to shine is over...

english: Are you sure you don't want to relax? Well, if you insist...
bulgarian: Are you sure you don't want to relax? Well, if you insist...

english: They might have some good ideas about how we could make more space.
bulgarian: They might have some good ideas about how we could make more space.

english: Well, if you insist on contributing...
bulgarian: Well, if you insist on contributing...

english: Adeline, didn't the vendors have some unusual materials requests for building their booths?
bulgarian: Adeline, didn't the vendors have some unusual materials requests for building their booths?

english: They certainly did! They're looking for $50 Voidite$, $20 Refined Stone$, $5 Mistril Ingots$, $10 Monster Cores$ and $5 Monster Blocks$.
bulgarian: They certainly did! They're looking for $50 Voidite$, $20 Refined Stone$, $5 Mistril Ingots$, $10 Monster Cores$ and $5 Monster Blocks$.

english: It'd be a huge help if you could handle gathering those for us, [Ari].
bulgarian: It'd be a huge help if you could handle gathering those for us, [Ari].

english: Thank you!
bulgarian: Thank you!

english: I'll set up the $Donation Box$ at the new plaza to the $west of the Blacksmith's$ for you.
bulgarian: I'll set up the $Donation Box$ at the new plaza to the $west of the Blacksmith's$ for you.

english: Just let me know when it's done!
bulgarian: Just let me know when it's done!

english: Thank you [Ari], and Adeline. I can't believe the Saturday Market is going to be growing again!
bulgarian: Thank you [Ari], and Adeline. I can't believe the Saturday Market is going to be growing again!

english: That's a great plan! I'll go see if Ryis and Landen are available.
bulgarian: That's a great plan! I'll go see if Ryis and Landen are available.

english: [Ari], can you go get March and Olric? And Nora, can you get set up in the Dining Room?
bulgarian: [Ari], can you go get March and Olric? And Nora, can you get set up in the Dining Room?

english: Well now, there's suddenly so much interest in our little market!
bulgarian: Well now, there's suddenly so much interest in our little market!

english: Before we talk about space, how about you tell us who the stand out applicants are, Nora?
bulgarian: Before we talk about space, how about you tell us who the stand out applicants are, Nora?

english: Well...
bulgarian: Well...

english: [Ari], I'm so glad you could make it! I've just finished filling Adeline in.
bulgarian: [Ari], I'm so glad you could make it! I've just finished filling Adeline in.

english: I'm so excited to see the new vendors, aren't you?
bulgarian: I'm so excited to see the new vendors, aren't you?

english: Thanks again for offering to help with gathering the materials for the new booths, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thanks again for offering to help with gathering the materials for the new booths, [Ari]!

english: Some of my finest woodcrafting! Those benches are practically works of art!
bulgarian: Some of my finest woodcrafting! Those benches are practically works of art!

english: See the $Plaza$ yet, [Ari]?
bulgarian: See the $Plaza$ yet, [Ari]?

english: You need $Refined Stone$ for the new vendor booths, right?
bulgarian: You need $Refined Stone$ for the new vendor booths, right?

english: Here, take these.
bulgarian: Here, take these.

english: Good luck with the rest.
bulgarian: Good luck with the rest.

english: I had a good time building the new $Plaza$. It's nice to see that empty land get some use!
bulgarian: I had a good time building the new $Plaza$. It's nice to see that empty land get some use!

english: We're going to have the best market for miles around!
bulgarian: We're going to have the best market for miles around!

english: Thanks again for supporting me with the market expansion, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thanks again for supporting me with the market expansion, [Ari].

english: I want you to know that I made sure not to have too much fun laying down the flagstone.
bulgarian: I want you to know that I made sure not to have too much fun laying down the flagstone.

english: Sorry that you couldn't help with building the $Plaza$, [Ari].
bulgarian: Sorry that you couldn't help with building the $Plaza$, [Ari].

english: I've been doing so much restoration work around Mistria that it felt nice to build something totally new.
bulgarian: I've been doing so much restoration work around Mistria that it felt nice to build something totally new.

english: Building the $Plaza$ was really fun!
bulgarian: Building the $Plaza$ was really fun!

english: Nora and I will take it from here.
bulgarian: Nora and I will take it from here.

english: You just look forward to seeing the new vendors at the next Saturday Market!
bulgarian: You just look forward to seeing the new vendors at the next Saturday Market!

english: You got all the materials for the new vendor's booths? That's so exciting!
bulgarian: You got all the materials for the new vendor's booths? That's so exciting!

english: Your timing is perfect! I'm sure you're eager to start helping Mistria and its citizens, so I'm here to tell you all about our town's $Request Board$. Come with me!
french: Tu tombes à pic ! Tu as sûrement hâte d'aider Mistria et ses habitants, alors je vais te parler du $panneau des requêtes$. Suis-moi !
russian: Ты как раз вовремя! Я уверена, тебе не терпится начать помогать Мистрии и её жителям, так что позволь рассказать тебе про $доску прошений$. Пошли со мной!
bulgarian: Точно навреме си! Сигурно нямаш търпение да помогнеш на Мистрия и жителите ѝ, затова искам да ти разкажа за нашето $Табло за заявки$. Ела с мен!

english: With your help we'll repair the earthquake's damage, raise Mistria's $Town Rank$, and put this village back on the map!
french: Avec ton aide, nous allons réparer les dégâts provoqués par le tremblement de terre, faire monter Mistria au $classement des villes$ et rendre à cette petite ville la place qui lui revient dans le royaume !
russian: С твоей помощью мы непременно восстановимся после землетрясения, поднимем $ранг$ Мистрии и вернём наш городок на карту!
bulgarian: С твоя помощ ще поправим щетите от земетресението, ще повишим $Ранга на града$ и ще върнем Мистрия на картата!

english: Why don't you go ahead now and accept your first $Request$? It's one I just put up for you!
french: Que dirais-tu d'accepter ta toute première $requête$ ? Je l'ai affichée spécialement pour toi !
russian: Почему бы тебе не принять своё первое $прошение$? Я поместила его на доску специально для тебя!
bulgarian: Сега приеми първата си $заявка$! Току-що я закачих за теб!

english: Perfect! That was easy, right?
french: Parfait ! Ce n'était pas compliqué, hein ?
russian: Прекрасно! Не сложно, правда?
bulgarian: Чудесно! Лесно беше, нали?

english: I'm sure you want to meet your new neighbors as much as they want to meet you!
french: Je suis certaine que tu as hâte de faire la connaissance de tes nouveaux voisins, tout comme eux ont envie de mettre un visage sur ton nom.
russian: Уверена, ты хочешь познакомиться со своими новыми соседями. Как и они с тобой!
bulgarian: Сигурна съм, че искаш да се запознаеш с новите си съседи толкова, колкото и те с теб!

english: And as you get to know them better, your $Journal$ can keep track of your relationships with them and even document their favorite gifts.
french: Et à mesure que tu apprendras à les connaître, ta relation avec chacun d'entre eux sera consignée dans ton $carnet de bord$. Tu y trouveras même les objets qu'ils aiment recevoir en cadeau.
russian: Когда познакомишься с ними поближе, в твой $журнал$ запишется информация об отношениях с ними. И даже о том, какие подарки им понравились.
bulgarian: А като ги опознаеш по-добре, $Дневникът$ ти ще следи отношенията ти с тях и дори ще записва любимите им подаръци.

english: And what do you like, Adeline?
french: Et toi, qu'est-ce que tu aimes, Adeline ?
russian: А что нравится тебе, Аделина?
bulgarian: А ти какво харесваш, Аделайн?

english: And what can I do to make you like me, Adeline?
french: Qu'est-ce que je peux faire pour te plaire, Adeline ?
russian: А что мне сделать, чтобы понравиться тебе, Аделина?
bulgarian: Как мога да те накарам да ме харесаш, Аделайн?

english: Well, =Tulips= are nice, and they are in season right now! I hope you'll be growing some on your farm!
french: Eh bien... J'aime les =tulipes= et il se trouve qu'on est en plein dans la saison ! J'espère que tu en feras pousser dans ta ferme !
russian: Ну, мне нравятся =тюльпаны=. Они сейчас как раз в сезоне! Надеюсь, ты вырастишь их на своей ферме!
bulgarian: Е, =лалетата= са хубави, а сега им е сезонът! Надявам се, че ще отглеждаш такива във фермата си!

english: Ah-
french: Ah...
russian: Ах...
bulgarian: А-

english: Well, I wouldn't say no to a =Tulip=, [Ari].
french: Eh bien, je ne refuse jamais une =tulipe=, [Ari].
russian: Ну, я бы не отказалась от =тюльпана=, [Ari].
bulgarian: Е, не бих отказала =лале=, [Ari].

english: A-Anyway we've still got a lot of things to talk about!
french: M-Mais il nous reste encore de nombreux sujets à aborder !
russian: В-в любом случае, нам ещё многое нужно обсудить!
bulgarian: Т-Така де, все още имаме много да си говорим!

english: You can view the $Map$ in your $Journal$. It should give you a good idea where people are, isn't that helpful? And each time you meet someone, it will update!
french: Tu peux consulter la $carte$ dans ton $carnet de bord$ pour savoir où se trouve chacun des villageois. Pratique, non ? Et à chaque fois que tu parleras à quelqu'un, il se mettra à jour !
russian: Ты можешь посмотреть $карту$ в своем $журнале$. На ней можно увидеть, где находятся жители. Полезно, да? И когда познакомишься с кем-то, она обновится!
bulgarian: Можеш да видиш $Картата$ в $Дневника$ си. Тя ще ти помогне да разбереш къде са хората. Полезно е, нали? И ще се обновява всеки път, когато се запознаеш с някого!

english: As the name implies, villagers post their $Requests$ here every day. You'll receive rewards whenever you complete them!
french: Comme son nom l'indique, les habitants y affichent leurs $requêtes$ tous les jours. À chaque fois que tu en termineras une, tu recevras une récompense !
russian: Как можно понять из названия, здесь каждый день жители размещают свои $прошения$. Выполнишь их задания — и получишь награду!
bulgarian: Както подсказва името, жителите оставят тук своите $заявки$ всеки ден. Ще получаваш награди, щом ги изпълниш!

english: You can think of this as the first step on our path to restoring the town.
french: Vois ça comme la première étape de la réhabilitation du village.
russian: Считай это первым шагом на пути к восстановлению города.
bulgarian: Може да го приемеш като първата крачка по пътя ни към възстановяването на града.

english: Isn't this exciting? Come talk to me once you're done meeting everyone!
french: Ce n'est pas génial ?! Viens me retrouver lorsque tu auras fait la connaissance de tout le monde.
russian: Разве не здорово? Поговори со мной, когда закончишь со всеми знакомиться!
bulgarian: Не е ли вълнуващо? Ела да поговорим, щом се запознаеш с всички!

english: It's a great way to earn $Money$, $Equipment$, and most importantly, $Renown$!
french: C'est un très bon moyen de gagner de l'$argent$, de l'$équipement$, et plus important encore, d'accroître notre $renommée$.
russian: Это отличный способ заработать $денег$, получить $экипировку$, и, что самое главное, улучшить $репутацию$!
bulgarian: Чудесен начин да спечелиш $пари$, $екипировка$ и най-важното — $известност$!

english: Renown?
french: Notre renommée ?
russian: Репутацию?
bulgarian: Известност?

english: Can't wait to get started!
french: J'ai hâte de m'y mettre !
russian: Не терпится начать!
bulgarian: Нямам търпение да започна!

english: Ah yes, let me explain the basics...
french: Ah oui, laisse-moi t'expliquer les grandes lignes...
russian: Ах, конечно, позволь рассказать...
bulgarian: А, да, нека обясня накратко...

english: I'm so glad! Allow me to explain the basics of $Renown$...
french: Ça me fait tellement plaisir ! Laisse-moi t'expliquer la $renommée$ dans les grandes lignes...
russian: Я очень рада! Позволь рассказать тебе про $репутацию$...
bulgarian: Толкова се радвам! Нека ти обясня накратко за $известността$...

english: As you know, Mistria is just one of the many towns that make up the Kingdom of Aldaria. All of them receive a $Town Rank$ according to their $Renown Level$.
french: Comme tu le sais, Mistria n'est qu'une des nombreuses villes du royaume d'Aldaria. Chacune d'elles se voit attribuer une place au $classement des villes$ en fonction de son $niveau de renommée$.
russian: Как тебе известно, Мистрия — лишь один из многих городов в Королевстве Альдария. Всем городам присваивается $ранг$, соответствующий $уровню репутации$.
bulgarian: Както знаеш, Мистрия е само един от многото градове в Кралство Алдария. Всеки получава $Ранг на града$ според $нивото си на известност$.

english: Towns with a higher $Town Rank$ enjoy more popularity and more support from the Capital.
french: Les mieux placées au $classement des villes$ sont plus populaires et reçoivent davantage de soutien de la capitale.
russian: Города с высоким $рангом$ популярнее и получают больше поддержки от столицы.
bulgarian: Градовете с по-висок $Ранг на града$ се радват на по-голяма известност и повече подкрепа от Столицата.

english: Mistria's $Renown Level$ was improving prior to the earthquake... Since then, though, we're down two entire $Town Ranks$.
french: Le $niveau de renommée$ de Mistria augmentait avant le tremblement de terre... mais depuis, nous avons perdu deux places au $classement des villes$.
russian: До землетрясения $репутация$ Мистрии росла... Но с тех пор мы опустились на целых два $ранга$.
bulgarian: $Нивото на известност$ на Мистрия се подобряваше преди земетресението... Но след него изгубихме цели два $Ранга на града$.

english: As daughter and heiress of Mistria's Baron, improving this situation is my highest priority.
french: En tant que fille et héritière du baron de Mistria, ma priorité est de faire en sorte que la situation s'améliore.
russian: Для меня, дочери и наследницы барона Мистрии, улучшить ситуацию — первостепенная задача.
bulgarian: Като дъщеря и наследница на барона на Мистрия, подобряването на положението е най-важният ми приоритет.

english: Hi there, [Ari]! I was hoping I'd run into you!
french: Salut, [Ari] ! J'espérais justement te voir.
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Тебя-то я и надеялось встретить!
bulgarian: Здравей, [Ari]! Надявах се да те срещна!

english: I'm used to roughing it, honestly.
french: Franchement, j'ai vu pire.
russian: Мне не привыкать к лишениям.
bulgarian: Свикнал съм да се оправям и сам.

english: No need!
french: Oui, mais non.
russian: Не стоит!
bulgarian: Няма нужда!

english: I'm Balor, a traveling merchant. Pleased to meet you.
french: Je m'appelle Balor, je suis marchand itinérant. Enchanté de faire ta connaissance.
russian: Меня зовут Балор. Я — странствующий торговец. Приятно познакомиться.
bulgarian: Аз съм Балор, пътуващ търговец. Приятно ми е да се запознаем.

english: Ahaha...
french: Ha ha ha...
russian: Ах-ха-ха...
bulgarian: Ха-ха...

english: You must be [Ari]! I'm Adeline, thank you so much for answering my request!
french: Tu dois être [Ari] ! Moi, c'est Adeline. Merci beaucoup d'avoir répondu à mon appel !
russian:
Ты, должно быть, [Ari]! Меня зовут Аделина. Спасибо большое, что

откликнулись

откликнуласьоткликнулсяоткликнулось на мою просьбу!
bulgarian: Ти трябва да си [Ari]! Аз съм Аделин, много ти благодаря, че отговори на молбата ми!

english: My brother and I are so excited to have a real adventurer here to help the town.
french: Mon frère et moi sommes ravis d'accueillir quelqu'un comme toi, qui aime l'aventure et qui souhaite aider notre petite ville.
russian:
Мы с братом так рады видеть

настоящих приключенцев

настоящую приключенкунастоящего приключенцанастоящего приключенца!
bulgarian: С брат ми сме много развълнувани, че тук ще ни помага <he>истински приключенец</he><she>истинска приключенка</she><they>човек с истински приключенски дух</they>.

english: I hope you like your new farm! It has a lot of potential, don't you think?
french: J'espère que ta nouvelle ferme te plaît ! Elle a beaucoup de potentiel, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian:
Надеюсь, тебе нравится твоя новая ферма! У неё большой потенциал,

осогласны

согласнасогласенсогласно?
bulgarian: Надявам се да ти хареса новата ти ферма! Има голям потенциал, не мислиш ли?

english: Why don't you come inside?
french: Et tu n'as pas vu l'intérieur. Entrons.
russian: Почему бы тебе не зайти внутрь?
bulgarian: Защо не влезеш?

english: Welcome to your new home!
french: Bienvenue dans ta nouvelle maison !
russian: Добро пожаловать в твой новый дом!
bulgarian: <he>Добре дошъл</he><she>Добре дошла</she><they>Добре дошли</they> в новия ти дом!

english: How cozy!
french: Je m'y sens déjà chez moi !
russian: Как уютно!
bulgarian: Колко е уютно!

english: Wow, that was fast!
french: Waouh, tu as fait vite !
russian: Ого, это было быстро!
bulgarian: Еха, това стана бързо!

english: I'm glad you think so!
french: Ça me fait plaisir que tu dises ça !
russian: Я так рада, что тебе нравится!
bulgarian: Радвам се, че мислиш така!

english: Haha...
french: Ha ha...
russian: Ха-ха...
bulgarian: Хаха...

english: Would you like a quick tour of the room?
french: Tu veux que je te présente rapidement ton logement ?
russian: Как насчёт небольшого тура по комнате?
bulgarian: Искаш ли набързо да ти покажа стаята?

english: Yes, please!
french: J'aimerais beaucoup !
russian: Да, пожалуйста!
bulgarian: Да, моля!

english: I'm good!
french: Ça ira, merci !
russian: Не нужно!
bulgarian: Добре съм!

english: Wonderful!
french: Fantastique !
russian: Чудесно!
bulgarian: Чудесно!

english: Let me guess, you're here at Lady Adeline's request? She mentioned someone had taken her up on her offer.
french: Laisse-moi deviner... Tu viens à la demande de dame Adeline, c'est ça ? Elle nous a dit que quelqu'un avait accepté son offre.
russian: Дай угадаю, ты здесь по просьбе леди Аделины? Она упоминала, что кто-то откликнулся на её предложение.
bulgarian: Да позная, тук си по молба на лейди Аделин? Тя спомена, че някой е приел предложението ѝ.

english: She said she was looking for a "capable adventurer"!
french: Elle cherchait une personne qui a « le goût de l'aventure » !
russian: Она говорила, что ищет «компетентного приключенца»!
bulgarian: Каза, че търси <he>„способен приключенец“</he><she>„способна приключенка“</she><they>„човек с приключенски умения“</they>!

english: There was something about free land and a house...
french: L'annonce parlait d'un lopin de terre et d'une maison...
russian: Там было что-то про бесплатную землю и дом...
bulgarian: Нещо за безплатна земя и къща...

english: Of course!
french: Comme tu voudras !
russian: Разумеется!
bulgarian: Разбира се!

english: This here is your $Diary$! You can write in it when you want to $record your story$.
french: Voici ton $journal$ ! Tu peux écrire dedans pour $sauvegarder ta progression$.
russian: Это твой $дневник$! Сюда можно $записать свою историю$.
bulgarian: Това тук е твоят $дневник$! Можеш да пишеш в него, когато искаш да $записваш историята си$.

english: And this of course is your new $Bed$!
french: Et voici ton nouveau $lit$ !
russian: А это, конечно, твоя новая $кровать$!
bulgarian: А това, разбира се, е новото ти $легло$!

english: Make sure you get to sleep by $2 am$ each day to keep your $Stamina$ up.
french: Veille à bien te coucher chaque soir avant $2 h du matin$ pour ne pas voir ton $endurance$ diminuer.
russian: Не забывай ложиться спать до $2 ночи$, чтобы восстанавливать $выносливость$.
bulgarian: Не забравяй да си легнеш до $2 ч. през нощта$ всеки ден, за да поддържаш нивото на $издръжливостта$ си.

english: We've also put this $Calendar$ up for you. You can use it to check when Mistria holds its $Festivals$ and to check when everyone in town's $Birthdays$ are!
french: Nous t'avons également accroché ce $calendrier$. Consulte-le pour connaître la date des $fêtes$ organisées à Mistria ainsi que l'anniversaire de chaque habitant !
russian: А еще мы повесили для тебя этот $календарь$.\nНа нём можно посмотреть даты $празднеств$ в Мистрии и $дни рождения$ жителей!
bulgarian: Поставили сме и този $календар$ за теб. Можеш да го използваш, за да проверяваш кога в Мистрия се провеждат $фестивалите$ и кога са $рождените дни$ на всички жители на града!

english: And this $Storage Chest$ here was made by Mistria's very own carpenter, Ryis!
french: Et ce $coffre de rangement$ a été fabriqué par Ryis, notre menuisier, ici à Mistria.
russian: А вот этот $сундук для вещей$ сделал наш местный плотник, Риз!
bulgarian: А този $сандък за съхранение$ е изработен от местния дърводелец на Мистрия, Райс!

english: You can $store items$ here if your bag starts to get too full.
french: Tu peux y $stocker des objets$ si ton sac est plein.
russian: В нем можно $хранить вещи$, которые не помещаются в твою сумку.
bulgarian: Можеш да $съхраняваш предмети$ тук, ако чантата ти започне да се препълва.

english: And that's about it for your tour!
french: Je crois que nous avons fait le tour !
russian: И на этом тур завершён!
bulgarian: И това е всичко от обиколката!

english: I thought you might be hungry when you got here, so I stopped by the Inn and picked up a bowl of their famous $Vegetable Soup$!
french: Je me suis dit que tu aurais sûrement un petit creux en arrivant, alors je suis passée à l'auberge pour t'apporter un bol de leur délicieuse $soupe de légumes$ !
russian:
Я подумала: ты, наверное,

проголодались

проголодаласьпроголодалсяпроголодалось с дороги, так что я зашла в трактир и взяла миску их знаменитого $овощного супа$!
bulgarian: Помислих, че може да си <he>гладен</he><she>гладна</she><they>гладни</they>, когато пристигнеш, затова минах през хана и взех купа от прочутата им $зеленчукова супа$!

english: Well I'm sure you're worn out from your long day. We won't keep you up.
french: Bien, cette longue journée a dû t'épuiser. Nous allons te laisser te reposer.
russian:
Что ж, я думаю, ты

устали

усталаусталустало после долгого дня, так что не будем задерживать.
bulgarian: Сигурно си <he>изморен</he><she>изморена</she><they>изморени</they> от пътуването. Няма да те задържаме повече.

english: Well, Mistria could certainly use the help to get back on its feet.
french: Un peu d'aide ne serait pas de trop ! Nous avons du pain sur la planche pour que Mistria retrouve sa splendeur.
russian: Ну, приключенцы бы нам точно пригодились! Чтобы поставить Мистрию на ноги, предстоит многое сделать.
bulgarian: Определено би ни помогнал такъв човек! Има много работа, за да върнем Мистрия на крака.

english: Welcome to Mistria, [Ari]. We're so glad to have you!
french: En tout cas, bienvenue à Mistria. Nous sommes heureux que tu sois là, [Ari] !
russian: Добро пожаловать в Мистрию, [Ari]. Мы очень рады тебе!
bulgarian: <he>Добре дошъл</he><she>Добре дошла</she><they>Добре дошли</they> в Мистрия, [Ari]. Радваме се, че си тук!

english: Let's meet up tomorrow so we can start discussing our plans for the town restoration.
french: Nous nous reverrons demain pour discuter de nos projets de réhabilitation du village.
russian: Давай встретимся завтра и обсудим планы по восстановлению города.
bulgarian: Нека се срещнем утре, за да започнем да обсъждаме плановете си за възстановяването на града.

english: I've seen the area! It's a nice spot, quite close to town.
french: Je connais l'endroit ! C'est un coin charmant, à deux pas du village.
russian: Я видел участок! Очаровательное местечко, и к городу близко.
bulgarian: Виждал съм района! Чудесно място е, съвсем близо до града.

english: I'll walk with you the rest of the way, if you don't mind the company. No wagons can get through since the bridge collapsed, so I've had to carry what I can on foot.
french: Si tu veux bien, je fais le reste du chemin avec toi. Les chariots ne peuvent plus passer depuis que le pont s'est écroulé, alors j'ai transporté tout ce que je pouvais à pied.
russian: Если ты не против компании, я провожу тебя. Через обвалившийся мост фургон не проедет, вот я и таскаю всё на своих двоих.
bulgarian: Ще те придружа през останалата част от пътя, ако нямаш нищо против компанията. Откакто мостът се срути, каруците не могат да минават, така че нося пеша каквото успея.

english: Great, let's go!
french: Bien, en route !
russian: Здорово! Вперёд!
bulgarian: Чудесно, да вървим!

english: Whew!
french: Pfiou !
russian: Фух!
bulgarian: Уф!

english: We should be able to make it before it gets dark. Come on, we'll head straight to your new farmstead!
french: Nous devrions arriver avant la tombée de la nuit. Viens, allons directement à ta nouvelle ferme !
russian: Думаю, успеем до темноты. Вперёд! Я проведу тебя прямо к твоему новому участку!
bulgarian: Трябва да стигнем преди да се стъмни. Хайде, ще отидем направо до новата ти ферма!

english: Oh? Hello there.
french: Bonjour !
russian: Ну привет!
bulgarian: Здравей!

english: Ah haha, I just help out around here. I actually used to be a miner! Then the earthquake hit and we had to close the $Mines$.
french: Ah ha ha ! Non, je donne juste un coup de main ici. Je travaillais dans les $mines$ ! Elles ont fermé après le tremblement de terre.
russian: Ах-ха-ха, я тут просто помогаю. Я раньше был шахтёром! Потом произошло землетрясение и $шахты$ пришлось закрыть.
bulgarian: А, хаха, просто помагам тук. Всъщност преди бях миньор! После земетресението удари и трябваше да затворим $мините$.

english: Hmph. Well enjoy your "chitchat" with my brother, but try not to waste too much of his time. Olric, come to my room when you're done, I need you to look over a blueprint.
french: Mmpf. Papote avec mon frère si ça te chante, mais ne lui fais pas trop perdre son temps. Olric, viens me voir quand tu auras fini, j'ai besoin que tu jettes à un œil à un plan.
russian: Хмф. Ну, наслаждайся болтовней с моим братом, но не трать слишком много его времени. Ольрик, как закончишь тут, зайди в мою комнату. Хочу, чтобы ты глянул один чертёж.
bulgarian: Хм. Забавлявай се с „приказките“ с брат ми, но гледай да не му губиш много от времето. Олрик, ела в стаята ми, като приключиш, трябва да прегледаш един чертеж.

english: Oh? If getting a handout from my brother counts as a "special request" I'm not sure I'd go bragging about it.
french: Oh ? Si récupérer un don de mon frère est une « requête spéciale », j'éviterais de m'en vanter.
russian: Да ну? Это получать подачки от моего брата — «особое поручение»? Я бы таким не хвастался.
bulgarian: А? Ако да измъкнеш подарък от брат ми се води „специална молба“, не бих се хвалил с това.

english: Olric, come to my room after you're done seeing [Ari] out.
french: Olric, viens me voir une fois que tu auras terminé avec [Ari].
russian: Ольрик, зайди ко мне в комнату, как закончишь и [Ari] уйдёт.
bulgarian: Олрик, ела в стаята ми, след като изпратиш [Ari].

english: Ah ha... sorry. He doesn't mean it.
french: Ah ha... Désolé, il ne pense pas ce qu'il dit.
russian: Ха-ха... Извини уж. Он это не специально.
bulgarian: Аха... извинявай. Той не го мисли наистина.

english: So um, as for my favor... If you could like, give March a chance, that'd be way cool of you. He doesn't have a lot of friends.
french: Alors, pour ce qui est de mon petit service... Si tu pouvais laisser une chance à March, ce serait sympa de ta part. Il n'a pas beaucoup d'amis.
russian: Ну, как бы там ни было... Если сделаешь мне одолжение и дашь Марту шанс, будет очень здорово. У него не очень много друзей.
bulgarian: Та, за моята молба... Ако можеш, дай шанс на Марч. Ще е много готино от твоя страна. Той няма много приятели.

english: I'll talk to you later, [Ari].
french: À plus tard, [Ari].
russian: Позже поговорим, [Ari].
bulgarian: Ще се видим по-късно, [Ari].

english: Aw, thanks for noticing! I used to be a miner, before the earthquake hit and we had to shut down the $Mines$. I just help out around here, my brother is the blacksmith in town.
french: Oh, tu as remarqué ! J'étais mineur avant le tremblement de terre, mais les $mines$ ont fermé depuis. Je donne juste un coup de main. C'est mon frère, le forgeron de la ville.
russian: О, приятно, что это заметно! Я раньше был шахтёром, до того, как произошло землетрясение и $шахты$ пришлось закрыть. Тут я просто помогаю брату. Он местный кузнец.
bulgarian: О, благодаря, че забеляза! Преди бях миньор, преди земетресението да удари и да се наложи да затворим $мините$. Сега просто помагам тук, а брат ми е ковачът на града.

english: If you want to know more about the $Mines$, you should talk to $Errol$! He used to be the Mine's Foreman but now he's our Museum Curator. I respect him a lot, he's way chiseled.
french: Si tu veux en savoir plus sur les $mines$, va parler à $Errol$ ! Il était contremaître avant. Il est conservateur du musée maintenant. Je l'admire vraiment. Il a de la bouteille.
russian: Если хочешь разузнать побольше про $шахты$, спроси $Эррола$! Он раньше был главным шахтёром, а сейчас курирует музей. Я его очень уважаю, он очень крепкий.
bulgarian: Ако искаш да научиш повече за $мините$, трябва да говориш с $Ерол$! Преди беше надзирател на мините, а сега е уредник на музея. Изглежда сякаш е издялан от камък.

english: Oh, that's right! I wanted you to have my old $Pickaxe$! Breaking rocks is a great way of getting toned!
french: Au fait, je voulais te donner mon ancienne $pioche$ ! Casser des cailloux, c'est parfait pour se muscler !
russian: Ах, точно, я хотел отдать тебе свою старую $кирку$! Колка камней кого угодно сделает спортсменом!
bulgarian: О, вярно! Исках да ти дам старата си $кирка$! Чупенето на камъни е чудесен начин да влезеш във форма!

english: It's a little old, but should be strong enough to break small rocks. If you want a stronger pickaxe, you'll have to $Forge$ it, or buy one from us here.
french: Elle date un peu, mais elle devrait suffire pour de petits rochers. Si tu en veux une plus robuste, tu devras la $forger$ ou nous en acheter une ici.
russian: Она слегка старовата, но с мелкими камнями ещё справляется. Если захочешь кирку покрепче, придётся воспользоваться $кузней$ или купить её у нас, здесь.
bulgarian: Малко е стара, но трябва да е достатъчно здрава за малки камъни. Ако искаш по-здрава кирка, ще трябва да я $изковеш$ или да си купиш от нас.

english: I'm glad you'll be putting this one to good use.
french: Je suis content de savoir qu'elle te servira.
russian: В любом случае я рад, что эта кирка ещё может тебе послужить.
bulgarian: Радвам се, че ще я използваш добре.

english: These days I help out my little bro March around our family forge! He's a great blacksmith but... uh... He's a little, well, not, like, great with other people-
french: En ce moment, j'aide mon petit frère March à la forge familiale ! C'est un super forgeron, mais... euh... il est un peu, disons... qu'il n'est pas très sociable.
russian: Сейчас я помогаю моему младшему бро Марту в нашей семейной кузне! Он отличный кузнец, но... ммм... Не очень хорошо ладит с людьми...
bulgarian: Напоследък помагам на малкия си брат Марч в семейната ни ковачница! Той е страхотен ковач, но... ъъ... как да го кажа... не се разбира особено с хората...

english: Olric, are you out here? I need-
french: Olric, tu es là ? Il me faut...
russian: Ольрик, ты здесь? Мне нужно...
bulgarian: Олрик, тук ли си? Трябва ми...

english: Huh. What are you doing here?
french: Hein ? Qu'est-ce que tu fais ici ?
russian: Хм? А ты что тут делаешь?
bulgarian: А? Какво правиш тук?

english: Hi, March!
french: Salut, March !
russian: Привет, Март!
bulgarian: Здрасти, Марч!

english: Don't you keep up? I'm here by special request!
french: Tu ne suis pas ce qui se passe ? Je viens répondre à une requête spéciale !
russian: Не следишь за новостями? Я тут по особому поручению!
bulgarian: Не следиш ли? Тук съм по специална молба!

english: Ah, here we are!
french: Ah, voilà !
russian: А, вот же она!
bulgarian: А, ето ни!

english: So you must be the blacksmith.
french: Donc, c'est toi, le forgeron.
russian: Ты, наверное, кузнец.
bulgarian: Значи ти си ковачът.

english: Wow you're incredibly ripped.
french: Waouh, tu es super musclé.
russian: Ого, ты такой мускулистый.
bulgarian: Еха, доста си як.

english: Mistria was once known for them! Rich in $minerals$ and $ores$ of all kinds. I was proud to be the Foreman.
french: Elles faisaient la gloire de Mistria autrefois ! Elles regorgent de $minéraux$ et de $minerais$ de toutes sortes. J'étais fier d'en être le contremaître.
russian: Мистрия ими раньше славилась! Очень богатая $минералами$ и $рудой$ самых разных видов. Я очень гордился, что был главным шахтёром.
bulgarian: Някога Мистрия беше известна с тях! Там имаше $минерали$ и $руди$ от всякакъв вид. Гордеех се, че бях надзирател.

english: So don't worry yourself about those $Mines$, eh? Some things are better left alone.

bulgarian: Затова не се тревожи за $Мините$, става ли? Някои неща е по-добре да оставим на мира.

russian: Ох? Ольрик сказал, что ты можешь спросить меня про $шахты$?
bulgarian: О? Олрик ти е казал да поговорим за $Мините$?

english: Thanks for taking my request, [Ari]! Now where did I put that $Pickaxe$...
french: Merci d'avoir accepté ma requête, [Ari] ! Bon, où ai-je mis cette $pioche$...?
russian:
Спасибо, что

приняли

принялапринялприняло мою просьбу, [Ari]! Так, куда же я дел $кирку$...
bulgarian: Благодаря, че прие молбата ми, [Ari]! Сега къде ли сложих онази $кирка$...

english: You gave us quite a scare.
french: Tu nous as fait une belle frayeur.
russian:
Ты нас всех

напугали

напугаланапугалнапугало.
bulgarian: Доста ни уплаши.

english: Please take your health more seriously, [Ari].
french: S'il te plaît, [Ari]. Fais plus attention à ta santé !
russian: Пожалуйста, заботься о своём здоровье, [Ari].
bulgarian: Моля те, отнасяй се по-сериозно към здравето си, [Ari].

english: You're lucky we found you by that dragon statue in the Mines.
french: Tu as de la chance qu'on t'ait retrouvé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> au pied de cette statue de dragon, dans la mine.
russian: Тебе повезло, что мы нашли тебя возле статуи дракона в шахтах.
bulgarian: Добре, че те открихме при статуята на дракона в Мините.

english: Well, I'm glad you seem to be doing better. Let's get you home to rest.

russian:
Что ж, я рада, что тебе стало лучше. Давай отведём тебя домой, чтобы ты

отдохнули

отдохнулаотдохнулотдохнуло.
bulgarian: Радвам се, че изглежда се чувстваш по-добре. Да те приберем да си починеш.

english: Ah, you're awake!
french: Ah, tu es réveillé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> !
russian:
А, ты

очнулись

очнуласьочнулсяочнулось!

bulgarian: Не ме плаши така!

english: Please take your health more seriously...

bulgarian: Моля те, отнасяй се по-сериозно към здравето си...

english: If not for your own sake, then for mine.

bulgarian: Ако не заради себе си, то поне заради мен.

english: Well, I'm glad you seem to be feeling better. Let's get you home to rest.

bulgarian: Радвам се, че изглежда се чувстваш по-добре. Да те приберем да си починеш.

english: [Ari], you're awake!

bulgarian: [Ari], най-сетне отвори очи!

english: Don't scare your wife like that!
